About the Role

We are looking for a Design Systems Engineer to lead the design system setup for our product. In this role, you will be responsible for turning fragmented UI into a highly scalable visual architecture. You will act as the crucial bridge between design and engineering, ensuring WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility is built-in from the ground up.

Primary Responsibilities

- Audit existing user interfaces to identify inconsistencies and areas for consolidation.
- Build and maintain scalable design tokens and variables.
- Construct and manage a master Figma component library.
- Document comprehensive usage guidelines for the design system.
- Bridge the gap between design and engineering teams to ensure seamless handoffs and implementation.
- Ensure all components comply with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
- Note: Candidates must provide a portfolio demonstrating Auto Layout and Variants work to be considered.

Technical Skills / Tools

- UI/UX design & Design systems thinking
- Atomic Design principles & Grid/layout standards
- Accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Design token creation & Component state management
- Design documentation & Developer collaboration
- Basic HTML/CSS literacy

description:
This is a remote position.

AXL Labs is looking for a UI/UX Designer Intern to craft intuitive and sleek interfaces. - Proficiency in design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, or similar), and familiarity with digital and social media formats.
- Attention to detail, strong time management, and the ability to handle multiple projects in a fast-paced clinical environment.
- Relevant education in design, visual communication, multimedia, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The Aditya Birla Capital (ABCL) has diverse, industry leading businesses across multiple verticals, including lending, life insurance, health insurance, insurance booking, mutual funds, housing finance, wealth management, insurance advisory services, retail broking, distribution of third party products etc. Rationale for the role lies in advantage of integrating strategic alliances and fintech partnerships centrally for pan-ABCL to maximise benefit at the most optimum economics

Challenges:

The biggest challenge is to compete in the new paradigm fintech where new competitors are making large investments from a long-term view, but ABC is making investments basis an annual break-even model. Moreover, our tech approach is traditional which creates a challenge in imagining and delivering innovative and agile tech solutions for new-age user experience.

As ABCL does not manufacture any products and is not licensed to sell any products, the core challenge of the job is the dependence on businesses to give simple and relevant products with ‘3-click’ digital journeys to purchase these products. The dependence also extends to Call Centre desks to close the sale in cases where customers prefer to talk to an agent.

Context:

Driving adoption of digital assets to acquire leads, customers, and revenue

Challenges:

Offscene Studio is looking for a Visual Designer who can translate ideas into compelling, thoughtful, and visually strong work across digital and print platforms.
You will collaborate closely with the Creative Lead, Creative Producer/Copywriter, Illustrator, Video Specialists, and Founder to create cohesive campaigns and visual communication for multiple brands.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving communication problems through design, has strong visual taste, is comfortable with feedback, and can adapt to different brand personalities.
At Offscene Studio, we value creative thinking and a clear design process as much as execution. Since we are a startup, the role requires an all-hands-on-deck mindset—you may work on social media creatives one day, a pitch deck the next, and campaign references, moodboards or final artwork after that.
Key Responsibilities-
Social Media & Campaign Design- Design static posts, carousels, stories, reel covers, thumbnails and digital ad creatives.
- Translate campaign concepts and communication ideas into strong visual directions.
- Create mobile-first, engaging and visually clear designs.
- Work across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, WhatsApp, websites and digital advertising platforms.
- Develop repeatable visual formats for social media calendars.
- Maintain consistency in typography, layout, hierarchy, spacing and visual language.
Brand & Visual Systems- Support the Creative Lead in developing brand and campaign visual systems.
- Work with colour palettes, typography, image treatments, graphic styles and layout systems.
- Develop mini brand guidelines and social media design systems.
- Adapt to different brand personalities while maintaining individuality for each brand.
- Create visuals that feel polished, premium, intentional and trustworthy.
Pitch Decks & Presentation Design- Design pitch decks, proposal decks, campaign presentations, moodboards and client presentations.
- Convert rough ideas and content into clean and visually compelling presentations.
- Collaborate with the Creative Producer/Copywriter to improve storytelling and communication.
- Create presentations that make concepts easy for clients to understand.
Digital & Print Collateral- Design posters, brochures, flyers, banners, marketing collateral and other brand assets.
- Prepare production-ready files for digital and print.
- Ensure correct dimensions, margins, bleeds, image quality, formats and exports.
- Maintain organised files and proper naming conventions.
Creative Collaboration- Collaborate with copywriters, illustrators, video specialists and the Creative Lead.
- Participate in brainstorming and contribute visual ideas.
- Develop moodboards, references, design routes and visual explorations.
- Translate scripts, campaign lines and concepts into visual communication.
- Ask relevant questions when briefs are incomplete or unclear.
- Take feedback positively and iterate efficiently.
Design Quality Control- Review typography, alignment, spacing, hierarchy, image treatment and overall consistency.
- Ensure every design meets Offscene's quality standards before delivery.
- Avoid generic, cluttered or rushed design solutions.
- Maintain strong design hygiene and continuously improve the visual quality of work.
Required Skills & Qualifications- 2–4 years of experience in visual design, graphic design, branding or a related creative role.
- Strong understanding of layout, typography, colour, composition, spacing and visual hierarchy.
- Strong visual taste with the ability to work across different styles and brand personalities.
- Excellent portfolio demonstrating creative thinking and quality execution.
- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and Figma.
- Ability to create engaging social media and digital creatives.
- Strong presentation and pitch deck design skills.
- Basic understanding of branding and visual identity systems.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Good communication and collaboration skills.
- Ability to explain the reasoning behind design decisions.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
- Open to feedback, experimentation and iteration.
- Comfortable using AI-assisted design tools thoughtfully for ideation, references and workflow enhancement.

title: UI/UX Designer:in – 100% Remote (m/w/d)
description:
## Über uns

Wir entwickeln eine intuitive B2B-App zur Steuerung mittelständischer Unternehmen. Um unser Team zu verstärken, suchen wir eine erfahrene und gestaltungsstarke Unterstützung in Teilzeit (ab 20 Std./Woche) an der Schnittstelle von UI/UX Design und Frontend-Entwicklung.

## Das erwartet dich

* Du designst moderne Oberflächen – benutzerfreundlich, ansprechend, intuitiv.
* Vom Konzept bis zum Release: du treibst den gesamten Design-Prozess voran.
* Neue Ideen setzt du schnell in klickbare Prototypen um (z. B. in Figma) und entwickelst sie iterativ weiter.
* Du übersetzt deine UI/UX-Konzepte direkt in sauberen Frontend-Code.
* Als Bindeglied zum Entwicklerteam arbeitest du eng und auf Augenhöhe mit ihnen zusammen.

## Das bringst du mit

### Fachlich

* Du lernst gern und nie aus.
* Kreativität ist deine Berufung.
* Erfahrung im UI/UX-Design (Figma)
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; gutes Englisch
* Du denkst logisch, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch mit.
* Grundlegendes BWL-Verständnis

### Sozial

* Du bist ein Energiegeber.
* Du bist empathisch und kommunikationsstark.
* Du arbeitest gerne proaktiv im Team mit.

### Persönlich

* Du bist initiativ und hast Schaffensfreude.
* Du willst Dinge voranbringen, eine gesunde Unzufriedenheit treibt dich an.
* Du bist effektiv und hartnäckig, wenn es darauf ankommt.

## Wir bieten

* 100% Remote – echtes ortsunabhängiges Arbeiten
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten – damit Arbeiten in deinen Alltag passt
* Teilzeit – Umfang nach Vereinbarung (mind. 20 Std./Woche)
* Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
* Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Aufstiegs- und Weiterentwicklungschancen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
* Eintritt ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

title: Product Designer - UX/UI & Design Systems (Remote)
description:
*Product Designer (UX/UI Designer – SaaS Products) – Remote*
------------------------------------------------------------

*Location:* Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico (Remote)
*Position Type:* Full-Time
*Working Hours:* U.S. Business Hours

*About the Role*
----------------

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a *Product Designer (UX/UI)* to own the end-to-end user experience across modern web and mobile SaaS applications.

This role goes beyond creating beautiful interfaces. You’ll combine *user research, product thinking, UX strategy, interface design, and scalable design systems* to build intuitive digital experiences that improve usability, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction.

Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into elegant, production-ready designs while ensuring consistency across the entire product ecosystem.

If you think in **user journeys, workflows, and systems—not just screens—**this role is built for you.

*What You’ll Own*
-----------------

*UX Research & Product Discovery*
---------------------------------

* Conduct user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.
* Translate research into:

* User personas
* Journey maps
* User flows
* Information architecture
* Product requirements

* Identify friction points and recommend UX improvements.
* Use product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel and Amplitude to support design decisions.

*UX/UI Design*
--------------

* Design wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity user interfaces.
* Create responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Design intuitive workflows that improve usability and task completion.
* Deliver polished SaaS experiences aligned with modern UX best practices.

*Design Systems & Component Libraries*
--------------------------------------

* Build and maintain scalable design systems.
* Create reusable UI components and design patterns.
* Establish standards for:

* Typography
* Color systems
* Spacing
* Interaction patterns
* Accessibility

* Ensure visual consistency across all product experiences.

*User Experience Optimization*
------------------------------

* Conduct usability testing and collect customer feedback.
* Run A/B tests on:

* Layouts
* User flows
* Navigation
* Interaction patterns

* Improve:

* User engagement
* Retention
* Feature adoption
* Conversion rates

* Iterate designs using research findings and product analytics.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*
--------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle.
* Participate in product planning, discovery sessions, and design reviews.
* Deliver developer-ready designs using:

* Figma Dev Mode
* Zeplin
* Design documentation

* Provide clear interaction specifications and implementation guidance.

*Accessibility & Design Quality*
--------------------------------

* Design experiences aligned with WCAG accessibility standards.
* Ensure usability across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
* Advocate for user-centered design principles throughout the organization.

*What Makes You a Strong Fit*
-----------------------------

* Strong product-thinking mindset with a passion for solving user problems.
* Excellent visual design skills with high attention to detail.
* Comfortable balancing user needs with business objectives.
* Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and eager to iterate.
* Data-driven approach to design decisions.
* Able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

*Required Experience & Skills*
------------------------------

*Experience*
------------

* 2+ years of Product Design or UX/UI Design experience.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating:

* Product thinking
* UX problem-solving
* User-centered design
* Responsive web and mobile design

*Core Skills*
-------------

* Proficiency with:

* Figma
* Adobe XD
* Sketch

* Experience creating:

* User flows
* Wireframes
* Interactive prototypes
* Design systems

* Strong understanding of:

* UX principles
* Accessibility
* Responsive design
* Usability testing
* Interaction design

*Nice-to-Have*
--------------

* Experience designing:

* SaaS platforms
* B2B software
* Enterprise applications
* Consumer products

* Experience maintaining scalable design systems.
* Familiarity with:

* Mixpanel
* Amplitude
* Product analytics tools

* Basic front-end knowledge:

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript

* Experience working in Agile product environments.

*Tools & Technologies*
----------------------

* Figma
* Adobe XD
* Sketch
* Mixpanel
* Amplitude
* Zeplin
* Product Analytics Platforms
* Collaboration & Project Management Tools

*What a Typical Day Looks Like*
-------------------------------

* Conduct user research and analyze product insights.
* Design wireframes, prototypes, and polished user interfaces.
* Build and refine scalable design systems.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers on new features.
* Run usability tests and improve user journeys.
* Deliver developer-ready assets and documentation.
* Iterate designs using customer feedback and analytics.

*In short:* You’ll design intuitive, scalable product experiences that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction while helping shape the future of the product.

*Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)*
--------------------------------

* Improved usability and customer satisfaction.
* Increased user engagement and feature adoption.
* Higher product retention.
* Reduced UX friction across key workflows.
* Consistent implementation of scalable design systems.
* On-time delivery of high-quality design assets.
* Strong collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.

*Why Join Us?*
--------------

* Own the end-to-end product design experience.
* Make a direct impact on product usability and customer outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leadership.
* Help build and scale modern design systems.
* Fully remote work environment with flexibility.
* Clear growth opportunities into:

* Senior Product Designer
* Lead Product Designer
* Design Manager
* Head of Design

*Interview Process*
-------------------

* *Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)*
* Portfolio Review
* Client Interview
* Offer & Onboarding

*What Happens After You Apply*
------------------------------

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from *Spark Hire* to record a short *3–5 minute Intro Video*. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Rather than repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your UX/UI design background, walk through your product design process, highlight relevant SaaS projects, and explain how you’ve approached user research, design systems, and cross-functional collaboration. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the portfolio review and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your *inbox* and *spam folder* for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

*Apply Now*
-----------

If you’re passionate about designing intuitive user experiences, solving complex product challenges, and building scalable SaaS products that users love, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape exceptional digital experiences that make a real impact.

# Job Title: Visual Communication Designer (Graphic Design + Video Editing)

**Location:** Vikas Nagar, Lucknow (On-Site)
**Experience:** 2–5 Years
**Company:** YogKulam

## About YogKulam

YogKulam is one of India's leading Yoga Teacher Training Institutes, dedicated to spreading authentic yogic wisdom through internationally recognized teacher training programs, workshops, retreats, and wellness education.

Our mission goes beyond teaching yoga—we aim to inspire transformation through meaningful experiences, powerful storytelling, and impactful visual communication. As we continue to grow our global presence, we're looking for a creative professional who can bring our brand to life across digital and offline platforms.

---

# We're Hiring – Visual Communication Designer

We're looking for a passionate **Visual Communication Designer** who excels in **Graphic Design** and possesses strong **Video Editing** skills to create engaging content that inspires our audience.

If you're someone who enjoys building beautiful brand experiences, creating scroll-stopping creatives, and telling stories through design and motion, we'd love to meet you.

---

# Key Responsibilities

### Graphic Design (Primary Responsibility)

* Design high-quality creatives for social media, advertisements, campaigns, emailers, presentations, brochures, standees, banners, certificates, merchandise, and print materials.
* Create compelling visual identities while maintaining brand consistency.
* Develop marketing creatives for lead generation, webinars, workshops, and promotional campaigns.
* Design landing page assets, website graphics, thumbnails, and digital marketing creatives.
* Work closely with the marketing team to convert ideas into impactful visuals.
* Prepare print-ready files with proper bleed, color profiles, and production specifications.

### Video Editing (Secondary Responsibility)

* Edit engaging Reels, Shorts, YouTube videos, advertisements, testimonials, podcasts, interviews, and educational content.
* Add motion graphics, transitions, subtitles, text animations, music, and sound effects.
* Repurpose long-form content into short-form social media videos.
* Optimize videos for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms.

---

# Required Skills

### Graphic Design

* Adobe Photoshop (Preferred)
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Strong understanding of:

* Typography
* Color Theory
* Layout & Composition
* Branding
* Print Design
* Visual Hierarchy

### Video Editing

* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects
* Motion Graphics
* Basic Animation
* Sound Design
* Color Correction
* Subtitle Creation

---

# Creative & Technical Abilities

* Strong visual storytelling skills.
* Excellent understanding of branding and marketing communication.
* Ability to create designs optimized for both digital and print media.
* Knowledge of aspect ratios, resolutions, export settings, codecs, and delivery formats.
* Ability to integrate stock assets, illustrations, icons, graphics, and animations seamlessly.
* Strong understanding of current social media trends and content styles.
* Ability to conceptualize campaigns from idea to execution.

---

# Professional Skills

* Excellent time management and project organization.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a collaborative environment.
* Open to feedback and quick iterations.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines without compromising quality.

---

# Bonus Skills

* Photography or Videography knowledge.
* Basic UI/UX Design.
* Illustration or Digital Art.
* Experience with AI-powered creative tools.
* Knowledge of Canva, Figma, Blender, or other creative software.
* Experience working in wellness, education, lifestyle, or healthcare brands.

---

# Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of professional experience in Graphic Design.
* Strong portfolio showcasing branding, marketing creatives, social media designs, print work, and video editing projects.

---

# What You'll Work On

* Social Media Campaigns
* Brand Identity
* Yoga Teacher Training Promotions
* International Marketing Campaigns
* Event Branding
* Educational Content
* Digital Advertisements
* Print Collaterals
* Website Graphics
* Reels & YouTube Videos
* Presentations & Pitch Decks

---

# What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with one of India's leading Yoga Teacher Training Institutes.
* Creative freedom to build a globally recognized wellness brand.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented work culture.
* Exposure to branding, performance marketing, content creation, and creative strategy.
* Diverse projects across digital, print, events, and international campaigns.
* Performance-based growth opportunities.

---

# How to Apply

Send your **Resume**, **Portfolio (PDF or Link)**, and a **short cover note** explaining your design philosophy to:

**📧 [hr.yogkulam@gmail.com](hr.yogkulam@gmail.com)**

**Application for Visual Communication Designer – [Your Name]**

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
--------------------
ABOUT PLAYPOWER LABS
--------------------

PlayPower Labs builds software for leading EdTech companies that serve millions of learners. We help our clients solve hard product and engineering problems so they can deliver better learner experiences through advanced technology, thoughtful design, and reliable execution.

We've been fully remote since before COVID and plan to stay remote. We are US-based, with a development center in Gandhinagar, India.

---------------
WHAT WE BELIEVE
---------------

*

We believe technology is a force multiplier for education.

*

Great software can make learning more engaging, effective, personalized, and accessible for millions of learners worldwide. The future of education will be shaped by advanced online learning, AI, and education data, and we want to help build that future.

*

Education data combined with AI is opening up new ways to create adaptive, personalized learning experiences. We're here to turn those opportunities into real products that learners, educators, and EdTech companies can actually use.

--------
THE ROLE
--------

We're looking for a high-energy product designer who wants to ship real experiences, not just push pixels in a file.

You'll design intuitive, engaging, AI-powered learning products used by students and educators around the world. You'll take problems from ambiguous to shipped: framing the problem, mapping the flow, designing the screens and states, and building clickable prototypes that prove the experience works. This role is for someone who can design a feature, prototype it fast, hand it off clean, and keep the user in control, especially when AI is doing the heavy lifting.

If you like moving fast, experimenting hard, and using AI as a real design multiplier, you'll fit right in.

You can find details on the interview process here

--------------
WHAT YOU'LL DO
--------------

*

Design UI/UX for AI-based experiences across EdTech web and mobile apps used by students and educators.

*

Own work end to end: problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and clickable prototypes.

*

Design user-facing AI/LLM features that reduce effort while keeping the user in control, with review, edit, and undo built in.

*

Apply vibe coding and modern AI design tools (Claude Design, Lovable, Figma) to go from idea to working prototype fast.

*

Build and maintain reusable components, variants, and design tokens so the product stays consistent as it scales.

*

Design for accessibility by default: clear labels, keyboard use, focus, contrast, useful errors, and status beyond color (WCAG 2.2 AA).

*

Design mobile-first, responsive interfaces that hold up on a phone and adapt cleanly to desktop.

*

Produce engineering-ready handoffs a developer can start building tomorrow: flows, states, validation rules, and component specs.

*

Collaborate in fast iteration loops with designers, engineers, product, and learning experts to sharpen user flows.

*

Bring energy, ideas, and momentum to a small team building real product.

----------------------
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
----------------------

*

A strong portfolio of shipped product design across web and mobile, with clear thinking behind the pixels.

*

Strong skills in Figma, and craft in visual and interaction design: hierarchy, spacing, typography, and states.

*

A genuine sense of product: you interrogate the brief, make assumptions explicit, and prioritize what matters.

*

Interest in designing for AI-enhanced, personalized user journeys, and keeping people in control of the AI.

*

Fluent with modern AI design and prototyping tools, and willing to keep experimenting as the tooling evolves.

*

Systems thinking: you design with reusable components, variants, and tokens, not one-off screens.

*

Accessibility-minded, with real care for how the product feels for every user.

*

Product-minded and comfortable moving without perfect instructions.

*

Startup energy: ownership, speed, curiosity, and no "that's not my job" attitude.

------------
BONUS POINTS
------------

*

You've designed for EdTech, or for students, teachers, or classrooms specifically.

*

You've built and maintained a design system, or shipped a real component library.

*

You can prototype in code (HTML/CSS, React, or tools like Lovable) to make handoffs sharper and iterations faster.

*

You've designed AI-powered product features and thought hard about failure states, guardrails, and human review.

-------------
WHAT WE OFFER
-------------

Remote work, competitive pay, real ownership, space to experiment, and a small team that cares about building good products without corporate theater.

title: Freelance Web Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Web Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality web designs for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in UI/web design, layout, and visual communication to transform briefs and concepts into clean, on-brand, and implementation-ready web designs. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in UI/web design, marketing pages, and digital visual communications.

What We Do
----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Web Designer, your focus will be on marketing pages, landing experiences, and conversion-driven layouts. We need a core specialist dedicated to owning the look and feel of all web-based materials, ensuring they feel consistent, polished, and perfectly aligned with the broader brand ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Design high-converting one-pagers, pitch-style landing pages, and simple marketing sites based on textual copy, outlines, or existing drafts.
* Translate brand assets and social media visuals into responsive web layouts, structured components, and sections that can be easily implemented by developers or no-code tools. • Prepare and securely package production-ready files (organizing Figma frames, exporting assets, and detailing specs) for seamless handoff.
* Ensure absolute visual consistency between interactive web pages, static PDFs, and social materials.
* Enforce layout quality standards through systematic verification of responsiveness, proper spacing, clarity, and adherence to modern web trends prior to delivery.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in web design, UI design, digital marketing design, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Web Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related creative/technical fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on landing pages, marketing websites, and product or startup one-pagers demonstrating clear hierarchy and strong typography. We are looking for specialists who are confident working from rough prompts, AI-generated drafts, or existing brand systems to convert them into structured, implementation-ready web designs. A user-centric, conversion-minded approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Web & UI Design: Deep proficiency in Figma for creating scalable, responsive web layouts, auto-layout components, and comprehensive design systems.
* Conversion-Driven Layouts: Expertise in structuring high-converting, pitch-style landing pages with a strong eye for clarity, spacing, and modern design trends.
* Developer Handoff: Solid understanding of how to prepare, spec, and package digital assets for efficient implementation via developers or no-code platforms (e.g., Webflow, Framer).
* Cross-Platform Consistency: Ability to seamlessly translate core brand aesthetics across varying touchpoints, ensuring web pages match existing social materials and pitch decks.

*Additional requirements*

* A structured, user-centric, and conversion-minded approach to design.
* Strong eye for clarity, white space, and modern web layout trends.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver production-ready assets fast.
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with web design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant web design cases, will not be considered.*

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$40 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Job DescriptionWe are a fintech company which is at the forefront of redefining the youth Banking space. We are building innovative technology solutions to empower teenagers and young individuals to thrive in the digital economy. We are seeking exceptional design talent to join our team and create user interfaces for both desktop and mobile platforms, with a strong emphasis on delivering top-tier user experiences.

Responsibilities
Design intuitive and visually compelling user experiences for web and mobile products.
Develop high-quality UX solutions, including wireframes, visual designs, prototypes, flow diagrams, storyboards, and site maps.

Providing advice and guidance on the implementation of UX research methodologies and testing activities in order to analyze and predict user behavior.

Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and marketers, you will be involved in the entire design process, from concept development to implementation.

Ensure that the visual design adheres to brand guidelines, effectively conveying the product's purpose and key messages to create a consistent and compelling user experience.

Collaborate in an agile environment, actively participating in design sprints and adapting to evolving project requirements.

Requirement
2+ years of experience as a UI/UX Designer, with a preference for candidates with experience in the banking or fintech sector.
. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as graphic design, interaction design, or a related discipline.

A portfolio of professional UI/UX design work for both web and mobile platforms.

Proficiency in design tools and technologies such as Sketch, InVision, Visio, HTML, CSS (SCSS), iOS, Android, Design Systems, and Adobe Creative Suite.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team while also being able to work independently.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong multitasking and time-management abilities, with the skill to prioritize tasks effectively.

Keen attention to detail and a passion for creating delightful user experiences.

Job Title: Lead UI/UX Designer
Location: Fluid Touch Pvt. Ltd., Financial District, Hyderabad
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

About Us
At Fluid Touch, we design purposeful and elegant apps that blend creativity with productivity. Our flagship product, Noteshelf, is one of the most loved note-taking apps on iOS and Android, used by students, professionals, digital planners, and creatives worldwide.
We’re on the lookout for a Lead UI/UX Designer with strong visual design skills and a deep understanding of user experience. If you have an eye for detail, a flair for aesthetics, and a passion for creative expression—this role is for you.

What You’ll Do
As the Lead UI/UX Designer for Noteshelf, you’ll play a key role in defining how millions of users interact with the app every day.
Your Responsibilities
- Own and lead the end-to-end design process—from discovery to high-fidelity execution.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define product goals and design intuitive, delightful interfaces.
- Mentor and guide a team of designers, ensuring quality and consistency across all touchpoints.
- Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and pixel-perfect UI for mobile and tablet platforms.
- Maintain and evolve the design system to scale consistently across features.
- Stay informed on the latest design trends, platform standards, and tools.

What We’re Looking For
- 5+ years of experience in UI/UX design, with at least 2 years in a lead or senior role.
- A strong portfolio that highlights thoughtful UX and clean, polished UI—especially on mobile and tablet.
- Solid understanding of visual design principles like typography, layout, spacing, iconography, and color theory.
- Proficiency with tools like Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar.
- Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams.
- Excellent communication and leadership skills.
- Experience in graphic design and illustration is highly desirable.
- A personal interest in journaling, digital planning, or creative hobbies like art, sketching, lettering, or stationery is a big plus!

Why Join Fluid Touch?
- Contribute to a top-rated product with a global user base.
- Be part of a team that genuinely values design and creativity.
- Make a real impact—your work will shape the experience of millions.

If you think you are the right fit, we’d love to get in touch with you. Apply now and help us shape the future of note-taking with Noteshelf.

At Trovex, we’re building an AI-powered platform that helps sales teams practice conversations, improve skills, and get better every day through intelligent roleplay and coaching.
Today, thousands of sales professionals across leading financial institutions already use Trovex to sharpen how they sell. But we believe the experience of learning, practicing, and improving sales skills can be dramatically better.
That’s where great design comes in.
We are looking for a UI/UX Designer with exceptional visual taste who wants to craft a product that feels simple, modern, and deeply intuitive.

What You’ll Work On

You’ll design the core experience of Trovex — where sales professionals:
• Practice conversations with AI
• Receive coaching and feedback
• Track improvement over time
• Learn through a modern, interactive platform

Your work will include:

- Designing beautiful, intuitive SaaS dashboards
- Crafting clean workflows and interaction patterns
- Turning complex product ideas into simple interfaces
- Building high-fidelity, production-ready designs
- Working closely with founders and engineers to ship quickly
- Using AI-assisted design tools to explore and iterate faster
This is a role for someone who cares deeply about craft and clarity.

What We Value

We care less about years of experience and more about taste, curiosity, and attention to detail.
You might be a good fit if you:
- Have 1–3 years of experience designing digital products
- Have a strong sense of visual design and typography
- Have designed SaaS dashboards, product interfaces, or complex workflows
- Think deeply about simplicity and usability
- Are comfortable working in Figma
- Are excited to experiment with AI tools in the design process
- Enjoy rapid iteration and product thinking

Bonus Points
- Portfolio shows clean, modern product interfaces
- Experience working in early-stage startups
- Exposure to design systems or component libraries
- Interest in AI products or intelligent interfaces

If you care about crafting products that are simple, elegant, and genuinely useful, we’d love to hear from you.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UI/UX Designer based in India.*

You’ll design intuitive, engaging digital learning experiences used by students and educators around the world.
The role covers the full product design lifecycle, from ambiguous problems and user flows to polished interfaces and shipped experiences.
You’ll work extensively on AI-powered and personalized learning features while ensuring users remain informed and in control.
You’ll collaborate closely with product, engineering, design, and learning experts in a fast-moving, highly iterative environment.
The position combines strong visual and interaction design with product thinking, prototyping, accessibility, and design systems.
You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to experiment with modern AI-powered design and development tools.
This is an ideal environment for a designer who wants to create meaningful products rather than simply produce static screens.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Design intuitive UI/UX experiences for AI-powered EdTech web and mobile applications serving students and educators.
* Own product design initiatives end to end, including problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and iteration through launch.
* Design AI and LLM-powered features that reduce user effort while preserving human control through appropriate review, editing, undo, feedback, and recovery experiences.
* Use modern design, AI, and prototyping tools such as Figma, Claude Design, and Lovable to rapidly explore concepts and create working prototypes.
* Build and maintain reusable components, variants, and design tokens to create consistent, scalable product experiences.
* Apply accessibility principles throughout the design process, including clear labeling, keyboard navigation, focus states, sufficient contrast, meaningful error messaging, and status indicators that do not rely solely on color in line with WCAG 2.2 AA.
* Create mobile-first, responsive experiences that work effectively across smartphones, tablets, and desktop environments.
* Produce detailed, engineering-ready handoffs covering user flows, interface states, validation rules, and component specifications.
* Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, product managers, and learning specialists through rapid iteration cycles to improve user journeys and product outcomes.
* Contribute ideas, experimentation, and momentum within a small, ownership-driven product team.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Demonstrated experience in product design with a strong portfolio showcasing shipped web and mobile experiences and the reasoning behind design decisions.
* Strong proficiency in Figma and solid visual and interaction design skills, including hierarchy, spacing, typography, responsive layouts, and interface states.
* Strong product thinking, with the ability to challenge assumptions, clarify ambiguous requirements, and prioritize the experiences and features that matter most.
* Genuine interest in AI-enhanced and personalized user experiences, particularly designing interactions that keep users informed and in control of AI-generated outcomes.
* Experience or strong willingness to work with modern AI-powered design and prototyping tools and continuously experiment as the technology evolves.
* Systems-thinking approach to design, with experience creating reusable components, variants, design tokens, and scalable design patterns rather than one-off screens.

Landor is looking for a Designer to join our Mumbai studio. Could this be you?

We are Landor, part of WPP

World-leading brand experts,

underpinned by the most expansive strategic & creative capabilities in our category.

We make brands more valuable and less vulnerable.

We build brands differently. We work with our clients to define and solve their business problems through the lens of brand. We strategically join the dots between our design, experience, governance and measurement capabilities, and always connect our brand work to business outcomes.

Landor companies also include amp (sonic branding), bdg (workplace & architectural experts), Deep Local (creative technologists) and ManvsMachine (3D motion design).

About WPP:

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. What You'll Do:

- Develop branding and packaging design solutions from concept to execution, translating strategy into compelling visual outcomes.

- Create and apply visual identity systems across packaging, digital, social, environmental, and communication touchpoints, demonstrating strong visualisation skills and fresh thinking.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work, leveraging AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and design development.

- Mindset: A highly creative mindset with meticulous attention to detail and a strong willingness to learn and adapt to rapid delivery cycles.
- Deliver the work on time and with in the schedule stays high priority

What We DoFlytBase is an AI-native company building the physical AI layer for the sky. Its platform powers fully autonomous drone-in-a-box operations across energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure sites worldwide—integrating drones, docks, edge AI, and enterprise workflows into one intelligent system. Headquartered in California with a fast-moving engineering base in Pune, FlytBase is redefining how the physical world is monitored and managed. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. At FlytBase, teams work in a high-agency, high-velocity environment where AI isn’t a side project—it’s the operating system for how they think, build, and grow.

With 300+ global deployments and 50+ partners in our ecosystem, FlytBase is powering the shift from human-operated to self-driven skies. Our platform transforms off-the-shelf drones into intelligent systems that sync effortlessly with enterprise infrastructure.

The RoleWe’re looking for a designer who sees design as leverage—something that shapes how the world sees us, tells sharper stories, and moves people to act. From websites and social campaigns to print collateral and quirky merch—you’ll shape the way the world sees FlytBase. You’ll jam with AI tools daily, turning rough ideas into sharp executions in hours, not weeks. This isn’t a pixel-pushing role. It’s a high-agency design role where you’ll conceptualize, experiment, and ship to a global audience.

What You'll Own• AI-Native Design: Use the latest AI tools like Midjourney, Runway, AnimateDiff, Higgsfield, HeyGen, and Veo 2 to generate assets and refine into world-class visuals.
• Multi-Channel Creative: Design across digital (website, social media, decks etc), physical (booths, print collateral etc), and branded merch (stickers, clothing, coasters etc).
• Cross-Functional Translation: Turn complex technical/product narratives into crisp and communicative graphics.
• Enterprise Storytelling: Use product imagery to explain our product in a way that Fortune 500 decision-makers actually get.
• 3D & Motion: Build 3D renders representing various concepts as part of dedicated campaigns.
• Systemized Design: Create reusable frameworks, branded components, and AI design workflows that scale across campaigns.

title: Pessoa Designer UI/UX Sênior com Inglês Avançado
description:
Somos inspired by tech powered by people. Por isso, precisamos de pessoas apaixonados por desafios e com sede de aprendizado contínuo.

Buscamos por novos makers para sonharem com a gente, que enxerguem além do óbvio e que estejam prontos para se juntar a nós nessa jornada de transformação e crescimento. Estamos expandindo nossos horizontes e buscamos pessoas que compartilhem dessa mesma paixão pela tecnologia e pelo aprendizado contínuo. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
-------------------------------

* Projetar experiências intuitivas e centradas no usuário para produtos de analytics, relatórios e inteligência comercial.
* Conduzir pesquisas com usuários, entrevistas com stakeholders e sessões de levantamento e descoberta de requisitos.
* Criar wireframes, fluxos de usuário, protótipos e designs de alta fidelidade.
* Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Product Owners, especialistas de negócio (SMEs), Analistas de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e equipes de Desenvolvimento.
* Garantir consistência entre interfaces de usuário, sistemas de design e produtos digitais.
* Apoiar testes de usabilidade e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
--------------------------

* Sólida experiência em Design de UI/UX para aplicações corporativas (enterprise).

* Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções para plataformas com grande volume de dados, dashboards, analytics ou soluções de BI.
* Conhecimento em pesquisa com usuários, testes de usabilidade e metodologias de design centrado no ser humano.
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de interagir com stakeholders de negócio.

* Experiência em ambientes Agile e em equipes de produto multifuncionais.

About the jobAt Bask Health, every role is AI-first. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into the right tools to explore and execute, is tested with real users and stakeholders, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of how we work, not side experiments.

We are looking for people who take full ownership of their work, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building a company that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

We’re looking for a Visual Designer to bring this mindset to all our growth, marketing, and sales initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates their passion for illustrative design and typography. This candidate will have experiences in working with numerous different design platforms such as digital and print forms.

What you'll do

- Define and shape our visual identity across our web presence, marketing channels, and product.

- Work closely with all our marketing initiatives big and small. This means executing to a high standard across everything from our website to sales collateral, social media assets and email campaigns.

- Help us come up with creative ways to reach our audience. We’d expect you to not just help us ship quickly at a high quality bar, but help us figure out what we do in the first place. It might be a new kind of campaign, a content series, a set of events – you name it, the less conventional, the better.

This is a great fit if you…

- Are excited about working in a company with design-focused engineers & founders, and a culture where craft and product sense play an important role. The level of attention on design work can understandably be daunting for some folks – we’d want you to be excited about it.

- Feel comfortable taking ownership in ambiguity. You should be happy with a bit of chaos and adrenaline that comes from being in a fast-moving product team.

- Prefer working in the open and default to sharing early and often. You seek input from the team vs iterating on your own and presenting only your final design.

This won't be the right role if you…

- Want a clear roadmap, with clearly scoped projects and tickets. We're early, growing quickly, and things are messy.

- Want to focus on how things look, rather than how they perform (in addition to how they look). We're looking for someone who is excited about metrics-driven experimentation while preserving a strong sense of taste.

- Want to only work on product. While you'll be joining a very product-centric culture and work closely alongside the product team, your role will be predominantly about designing how we communicate the product, not the product itself.

- Expect all the perks of a big company. We’re a seed-stage startup and are competitive in what we offer at our stage, but it’s a different role and opportunity than working at an established tech company.

Requirements

- Feel at home working in Figma. You should be very comfortable making things on the web and obsess over making things look and feel great.

- Have an intuitive sense for good copy and how it can effectively convey an idea. You should be able to tell when a few changes to a headline really make a page sing and how words and visuals play together.

- Have worked for product-led companies, ideally in SaaS. You should have an intuitive sense of how products like ours look and how they are marketed.

- Ideally know your way around HTML and CSS a bit. We don’t expect you to be an expert by any stretch, but you should be comfortable fixing background colours in a pull request on Github.

- Ideally have experimented with video a bit and are excited to grow this area of your skill set.

About the jobAt Bask Health, every role is AI-first. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into the right tools to explore and execute, is tested with real users and stakeholders, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of how we work, not side experiments.

We are looking for people who take full ownership of their work, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building a company that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

We’re looking for a Visual Designer to bring this mindset to all our growth, marketing, and sales initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates their passion for illustrative design and typography. This candidate will have experiences in working with numerous different design platforms such as digital and print forms.

What you'll do

- Define and shape our visual identity across our web presence, marketing channels, and product.

- Work closely with all our marketing initiatives big and small. This means executing to a high standard across everything from our website to sales collateral, social media assets, and email campaigns.

- Help us come up with creative ways to reach our audience. We’d expect you not just to help us ship quickly at a high-quality bar, but to help us figure out what we do in the first place. It might be a new kind of campaign, a content series, a set of events – you name it, the less conventional, the better.

- Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point — to clarify thinking, draft output, research problems, and move faster. Apply your own judgment to refine quality and make it count.

- Validate and iterate: Test your work with real users and stakeholders. Use what you learn to improve before problems become patterns.

- Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across your team so we raise the bar together.

This is a great fit if you…

- Are excited about working in a company with design-focused engineers & founders, and a culture where craft and product sense play an important role. The level of attention on design work can understandably be daunting for some folks – we’d want you to be excited about it.

- Feel comfortable taking ownership of ambiguity. You should be happy with a bit of chaos and adrenaline that comes from being in a fast-moving product team.

- Prefer working in the open and default to sharing early and often. You seek input from the team vs iterating on your own and presenting only your final design.

This won't be the right role if you…

- Want a clear roadmap, with clearly scoped projects and tickets. We're early, growing quickly, and things are messy.

- Want to focus on how things look, rather than how they perform (in addition to how they look). We're looking for someone who is excited about metrics-driven experimentation while preserving a strong sense of taste.

- Want to only work on product. While you'll be joining a very product-centric culture and working closely alongside the product team, your role will predominantly be designing how we communicate the product, not the product itself.

- Expect all the perks of a big company. We’re a seed-stage startup and are competitive in what we offer at our stage, but it’s a different role and opportunity than working at an established tech company.

- This is NOT a UI/UX position

Requirements

- Feel at home working in Figma. You should be very comfortable making things on the web and obsess over making things look and feel great.

- Have an intuitive sense for good copy and how it can effectively convey an idea. You should be able to tell when a few changes to a headline really make a page sing and how words and visuals play together.

- Have worked for product-led companies, ideally in SaaS. You should have an intuitive sense of how products like ours look and how they are marketed.

- Ideally know your way around HTML and CSS a bit. We don’t expect you to be an expert by any stretch, but you should be comfortable fixing background colours in a pull request on Github.

- Ideally have experimented with video a bit and are excited to grow this area of your skill set.

The Creatives Bench is a boutique creative recruitment agency based in Hyderabad. We are currently hiring on behalf of a Hyderabad-based agency looking for a talented Lead Designer to join their team. All applications and initial hiring stages will be managed directly by The Creatives Bench.

YOUR DAY-TO- DAY
• Design websites end to end, from the first wireframe to the final polished screen, for brands that need their site to actually convert, not just look nice.
• Build and maintain design systems in Figma that the whole team can work from, so nothing looks like it was designed by five different people.
• Take a client brief and turn it into a site structure that makes sense before a single pixel gets placed.
• Prototype in Framer with enough detail that a client can click through and feel the final product, not imagine it.
• Move between desktop and mobile thinking naturally, since a layout that works on one rarely survives untouched on the other.
• Work closely with developers, so what you design actually holds up once it's built, not just in the file.
• Building pages, customizing themes, making sure what ships matches what was designed.
• Stay sharp on what's current in web design and typography, and know the difference between a trend worth using and one worth skipping.
• Test your own designs like a user would, catching the friction points before a client or their customer ever does.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
• You're fluent in Figma, Adobe XD and Framer, and you know which one to reach for depending on what the project needs.
• You understand the basics of how websites actually get built, so your designs are grounded in what's technically possible, not just what's pretty.
• Comfortable working in WordPress, from page building to light customization.
• Detail-oriented to a fault. Spacing, alignment, and consistency aren't afterthoughts, they're the job.
• You keep a genuine pulse on design trends and aesthetics, and you can tell when something's worth borrowing versus worth ignoring.
• You think in user flows, not just screens, and you can explain why a design choice works, not just that it does.

Shreeyaa V Bhandary

Shreeyaa V Bhandary

Making Clean Air Abundant @Praan

Background
Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep-tech startup democratizing clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.

Why
Everyone worries about the dooms-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.

Job Overview
Praan’s team solves nuanced technical problems using design, cutting edge engineering, and manufacturing. However, this nuance serves as a high barrier for usability if the software, brochures, manuals, and other marketing materials aren’t able to convey the concepts simply and visually. title: Junior / Trainee Graphic Designer (Merch and Visual Design)
description:
Ми шукаємо молодого дизайнера на початку його професійного шляху - людину, яка є допитливою, креативною та щиро захоплюється візуальним дизайном. Ця роль для тих, хто вже експериментує з Photoshop або Illustrator, можливо навчався самостійно, створює графіку для себе, досліджує AI-інструменти або просто любить проводити багато часу за дизайном. Для цієї позиції не потрібен багаторічний досвід роботи. Набагато важливіші: візуальний смак, цікавість до дизайну та велике бажання розвиватися.

Кому підійде ця роль: дана позиція може стати гарним стартом для людини, яка
любить візуальний дизайн та графіку
любить експериментувати з типографікою, текстурами або ілюстраціями
можливо малює або робить скетчі
цікавиться брендингом, мерчем або fashion-графікою
хоче зрозуміти, як працює дизайн у реальному продуктовому середовищі

Базові навички: комерційний досвід не є обов’язковим, але важливо, щоб ви вже знали основи та могли створювати просту графіку. Базово ми очікуємо знання таких інструментів: Adobe Photoshop та Adobe Illustrator.

Буде плюсом:
профільна вища освіта
англійська від Upper-Intermediate
досвід роботи або базове розуміння Figma
досвід використання AI-інструментів для дизайну
навички ілюстрації або малювання
інтерес до типографіки та експерименти зі шрифтами
базові навички анімації / motion-графіки

Основні задачі:
На початку основний фокус буде на внутрішніх дизайн-задачах, які допоможуть вам отримати практичний досвід та розвинути власний стиль.
Приклади задач:
створення дизайнів для мерчу (футболки, худі, принти) для внутрішнього бренду компанії
допомога маркетинговій команді з банерами та візуальними матеріалами
експерименти з графікою, типографікою та композицією
допомога у створенні ідей для логотипів та візуальних концепцій
дослідження різних стилів візуальної айдентики

Важливо розуміти, що ця позиція створена для початківців.
На старті основний фокус буде на практиці та навчанні та ви працюватимете переважно з внутрішніми проєктами, поступово набираючись досвіду та розвиваючи власний стиль. Компенсація на початку буде помірною, проте ця роль дає можливість отримати реальний досвід роботи в середовищі IT-компанії, отримувати фідбек і підтримку від більш досвідчених дизайнерів та поступово формувати сильне портфоліо. Якщо ви справді захоплюєтесь дизайном і готові вкладати час у навчання та експерименти - ця позиція може стати чудовим першим кроком у вашій кар’єрі.
Наразі ми не шукаємо впевнений досвід - ми шукаємо великий потенціал та щиру зацікавленість у дизайні.

Як податись на вакансію:

напишіть кілька слів про себе (розкажіть коротко про себе як людину: як ви прийшли у дизайн, що вам у ньому найбільше подобається або що вас зацікавило у цій ролі. Можна написати будь-що, що, на вашу думку, допоможе нам трохи краще познайомитися з вами.)
надішліть, будь ласка, приклади ваших робіт (ке можуть бути: постери, логотипи,графіка, ілюстрації, концепти мерчу, експерименти з типографікою, особисті або навчальні проекти). Не хвилюйтеся, якщо ваші роботи здаються занадто експериментальними, незвичайними або «не надто серйозними», які ви створювали просто для себе - обов’язково поділіться ними. Іноді саме такі роботи найкраще показують потенціал дизайнера.

Що ми пропонуємо:

* Практичний досвід у реальних проєктах – можливість працювати над задачами у середовищі IT-компанії та формувати власне портфоліо.
* Професійний розвиток – доступ до внутрішніх навчальних програм, воркшопів та освітніх матеріалів для розвитку професійних навичок.
* Робота в компанії з міжнародними клієнтами – можливість отримати досвід співпраці з відомими брендами та різними індустріями.
* Корпоративні знижки та партнерські програми – спеціальні пропозиції для співробітників та їхніх родичів від партнерських компаній, включаючи одну з найбільших мереж спортзалів в Україні.
* Баланс роботи та відпочинку

21 календарний день оплачуваної відпустки,
15 оплачуваних лікарняних днів та додаткові вихідні за потреби.

title: UX Design Intern
description:
This is not your typical internship. There are no coffee runs, no busywork, and no fighting 200 other applicants for one spot.

GWEN is an AI-powered UX internship where you work on real-world design projects with AI teammates and a mentor. You'll build portfolio-ready case studies, get detailed feedback on your work, and receive a reference letter on completion.

Upfront, because it matters: This is a paid training programme, not employment. The job interview and your first project are free. The full internship is a one-time $199, and regional pricing applies automatically in lower-income countries.

*How it works:*

*

Pass a simulated job interview, then start your first project the same day

*

Your first project is free: tear down a real client's signup flow with your mentor, redesign it, and get both screens reviewed

*

Work through 7 structured UX projects at your own pace, from anywhere

*

Collaborate with AI teammates who challenge your thinking and give real-time feedback

*

Build portfolio pieces you can actually show employers

There is no salary and no job offer at the end. What you get is practice, feedback and proof of work: the three things every junior UX application is missing.

*

A laptop or desktop (the internship doesn't run on phones)

*

Interest in UX design (student, fresher, graduate)

*

Self-motivated and able to work independently

*

Willingness to learn, take feedback, and build something you're proud of

*Benefits:*

Reference letter at completion, certificate and a portfolio review on request. Pay once, keep lifetime access including future projects.

What others are saying, like Michael Ghaliy: "This internship will improve your skills and ability putting your hands on real project briefs using AI tools, and learn to be confident and successful in finding a job."

title: UI/UX and Digital Designer – Freelance
description:
We are looking for a creative and technically minded UI/UX & Digital Designer to join our team full-time and take ownership of the visual design of an innovative digital product.

Your main focus will be the UI/UX design of a mobile app, working closely with our developers from concept through implementation. We already have an existing design direction and extensive mockups. Your role will be to take over this work, develop it further, and ensure a consistent and high-quality design across the entire product.

We work actively with AI-assisted design tools, especially Claude Design. We are therefore looking for someone who is excited about modern AI workflows and can use them professionally rather than relying exclusively on traditional design processes.

Your responsibilities
Take ownership of the UI/UX design of our mobile app
Continue and improve an existing app design and design system
Create new screens, user flows, components, states, and interactions
Work with Claude Design to create and iterate designs efficiently
Prepare clear design releases for our development team
Work closely with developers during implementation
Review implemented screens and ensure visual consistency and quality
Maintain an overview of the complete product design
Think beyond individual screens and understand the overall user experience

In addition to the app, we would like you to support us with other design tasks, including:
Social media content and campaign visuals
Advertising creatives and digital marketing assets
Landing pages and websites
Interactive and immersive web experiences
Scrollytelling websites and modern web animations
Other digital design tasks across our projects

Where appropriate, these assets should also be created efficiently with Claude Design and other AI tools.

What we are looking for
You should have strong experience in UI/UX and app design and a good understanding of how designs are translated into real products.

Experience with some of the following is especially valuable:
Mobile app UI/UX
Responsive design
Design systems and reusable components
Claude Design or similar AI design/coding tools
AI-assisted creative workflows
Working directly with developers
Interactive websites
Scrollytelling
Immersive web experiences
Motion and interaction design
Social media and advertising design

Experience with Figma is welcome, but we are not looking for someone who is tied to one specific design tool. We care much more about your ability to create excellent digital experiences and work efficiently with modern tools and AI.

If you have already designed immersive, interactive or scrollytelling websites, please include examples in your portfolio.

How we work
Full-time: 160 hours/month
Fully remote
Flexible working hours
Online office and close collaboration with the team
Direct cooperation with developers and project management
Modern, AI-supported workflows
High level of creative responsibility
Additional bonus payments based on performance and project success

The initial focus will be on one major app project, but we are looking for someone who can also support our other digital projects and grow with us.

Application
Please send us:
A short introduction about yourself
Your portfolio
Examples of mobile app/UI/UX projects
Examples of interactive, immersive or scrollytelling projects, if available
Your experience with Claude, AI design tools or AI-assisted workflows
Your monthly salary expectation for 160 hours
Your availability / possible starting date

title: Middle UI/UX Designer
description:
Middle UX/UI Designer

We are a team of first-class professionals with great ambitions, looking for a UX/UI Designer with experience, and desire to learn and grow with us.

Our vision: to make the world better and people happier with our design products.
We aspire to create interfaces and experiences that reach millions – transforming businesses and delivering growth to our clients.

Join our team in the search of greatness!

Job Description

As a UX/UI Designer, you will be working with the Project Manager and Art Director during the full life-cycle of building the digital product – from research and ideation to the final deliverables, creatively approaching constraints.

You can become a part of our team, if:

* You have 2+ years of commercial experience as a UX/UI designer
* You have superb knowledge of Figma & AI tools
* Knowledge of English at the level of Upper-Intermediate and above
* You are a black belt in designing for Web, IOS, and Android platforms;
* And practical experience of creating design systems / UI Kits
* You understand the principles of adaptive and responsive layout
* You are able to participate in 2-3 projects simultaneously and to meet deadlines
* Your portfolio is a subject of your pride
* You, like us, are in a relentless pursuit of creative solutions and personal development

It will be a plus if you have:

* Knowledge of Motion Design tools, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, 3D Graphic Tools
* Experience in designing and creating illustrations
* Knowledge of interface development steps
* Sense of humor - no kidding:)

Reasons to join us:

* Remote work;
* Flexible schedule, with a standard 40 hours a week schedule;
* Market salary fixed in USD (based on level of experience & portfolio)
* Paid vacation, sick leaves, holidays
* Interesting foreign projects which bring value into this world. We do not work with questionable areas like casinos or gambling.
* Professional Art Direction by Design Director with 12+ years experience. Soak in all that knowledge!
* Engagement in team development and design processes. You will have enough independence to make decisions that can affect not only the project, but also the work of the company.
* Regular compensation reviews based on performance
* Possibilities of vertical and horizontal growth within the company
* Education and trainings are partially paid by the agency after 6 months in the company
* We are ready to support your well-being in various ways, and our focus is maintaining your work-life balance in check.

Everyone dreams of a working process without burnouts, and we are going to turn this into reality.

If you’re still here and would like to join us, we look forward to hearing from you!

Please note that only the candidates with the following will be considered:

* Link to your amazing portfolio (Figma links accepted)
* Your expected salary

Feel free to share any meme you like in your job application

title: Product UI/UX Designer
description:
Ми розвиваємо міжнародну платформу для онлайн-знайомств і шукаємо Product UI/UX Designer, який допоможе нам створювати web-продукти, якими хочеться користуватися - і які при цьому показують сильні бізнес-результати.
У нас велика кількість користувачів, багато трафіку та постійний потік продуктових задач. Тому нам потрібен дизайнер, який мислить не тільки екранами та візуалом, а user journey, конверсією, поведінкою користувачів та бізнес-метриками.
Ти працюватимеш безпосередньо з Product та Marketing командами, Data Analysts і розробниками - від пошуку проблеми та формування гіпотези до дизайну, запуску та аналізу результатів.

Обов'язки
Проєктування та розвиток web-продуктів у сфері online dating.
Створення та покращення ключових user flows: registration, onboarding, profile creation, discovery, matching, messaging, engagement та monetization.
Аналіз User Journey та пошук точок friction, drop-off і можливостей для зростання конверсії.
Розробка UX/UI для нових фічей та покращення існуючих продуктових сценаріїв.
Створення wireframes, prototypes та high-fidelity designs у Figma.
Формування UX/UI гіпотез на основі даних, поведінки користувачів та бізнес-задач.
Співпраця з Product Managers, Product Marketers, Data Analysts та розробниками.
Участь у плануванні та проведенні A/B-тестів дизайнів і продуктових сценаріїв.
Аналіз результатів тестів та ітеративне покращення рішень.
Робота над конверсією ключових етапів продуктової воронки.
Робота з monetization flows, paywalls, subscription / purchase flows та іншими конверсійними сценаріями.
Аналіз конкурентів та пошук нових UX/UI підходів для dating-продуктів.
Підтримка та розвиток дизайн-системи.

Що нам важливо
4+ роки досвіду у Product / UX/UI Design.
Досвід дизайну web-продуктів.
Сильне портфоліо з прикладами продуктових задач та кейсів.
Впевнене володіння Figma.
Глибоке розуміння UX/UI та принципів побудови сучасних web-продуктів.
Досвід роботи з user flows, wireframes, prototypes та high-fidelity designs.
Розуміння принципів conversion optimization та продуктової воронки.
Досвід роботи з A/B-тестуванням або продуктовими експериментами.
Вміння використовувати дані та дослідження поведінки користувачів для прийняття дизайн-рішень.
Розуміння продуктових метрик та їхнього зв'язку з UX.
Сильне product thinking та business thinking.
Вміння аргументувати дизайн-рішення та захищати їх перед стейкхолдерами.
Високий рівень автономності та ownership.

Буде плюсом
Досвід роботи саме з dating / social / subscription продуктами.
Досвід роботи з growth та conversion optimization.
Досвід роботи з monetization / paywall / subscription flows.
Досвід проведення UX-досліджень.
Досвід роботи з великими consumer-продуктами.
Розуміння HTML/CSS та базових frontend-обмежень.
Досвід використання AI-інструментів у design workflow.

Що ми пропонуємо
⚡ Мінімум бюрократії та швидкий цикл прийняття рішень - від ідеї до реалізації без довгих погоджень.
💰 Конкурентну винагороду - відповідно до рівня експертизи, досвіду та впливу ролі на продукт.
🌍 Повністю remote - можливість працювати з будь-якої точки світу, Europe-friendly time zone.
💪 Сильну автономну команду без мікроменеджменту - цінуємо ініціативність, відповідальність та здатність самостійно знаходити рішення.
📈 Реальний вплив на продукт - твої рішення безпосередньо впливатимуть на UX, конверсію, engagement та monetization.
🎨 End-to-end ownership - від дослідження проблеми та формування гіпотези до дизайну, запуску та аналізу результатів.

Етапи відбору
Співбесіда з HR.
Фінальна співбесіда з Head of Product / Design.
Portfolio review / тестове завдання.

title: Middle UI/UX Designer (Gamedev / Gamification)
description:
Live Animations is a Ukrainian gamification company. We create and integrate games and gamified mechanics into mobile applications and digital products for leading brands.
Our projects reach millions of users. Our partners include Silpo, Sense Bank, Nova Poshta, Uklon, Mastercard, Auchan, Kaufland, and other leading Ukrainian and international brands.

We help businesses grow through gamification by increasing retention, user engagement, and app interaction frequency. We develop everything from eye-catching seasonal activations to complex long-term gaming ecosystems.

Position: Middle UI/UX Designer (Gamedev / Gamification)
Work format: Hybrid (Kyiv, 1–2 days in the office) or fully remote
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00

We are looking for a talented designer who can create not only visually stunning game graphics but also design logical, intuitive, and engaging interfaces for millions of players.

Your daily focus:
UX/UI Design: Design UI kits, game interfaces, windows, and screen layouts — from the first wireframes to the final polish.
Gamification: Design user experience logic (UX flows) that immerses players and keeps them engaged.
Graphic Design: Create and adapt game assets, icons, buttons, and promotional materials.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with developers and PMs, prepare design files for implementation, and hand them over to the development team.

Your background:
Experience: 2+ years of UI/UX design experience in Gamedev or Mobile Games (a portfolio featuring game interfaces is required).
Tools: Figma at an expert level (components, auto layouts, wireframes, UI kits). Confident proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator for creating and editing 2D graphics.

Skills & Mindset:
Strong understanding of mobile game development, game usability, and UX best practices.
Excellent sense of style, colour, composition, and attention to even the smallest pixel.
A visual storyteller who can confidently explain design decisions and openly embrace constructive feedback.

What you’ll get:
Projects — Design game UI/UX for products used by millions of users.
Team — A friendly, creative environment with no micromanagement or tedious reporting.
Growth — Continuous learning, knowledge sharing with a creative team, and real professional growth through challenging projects.
Flexibility — Choose between comfortable remote work or a cozy office in Kyiv.
Work-Life Balance — 17 days of paid vacation to recharge and maintain a healthy balance.

📩 Already picturing your interfaces in our products? Send us your portfolio and CV — we’d love to get to know you!
