title: Mobile UI/UX Designer
description:
Про нас:
Button — застосунок, який допомагає покликати близьких, коли це справді важливо. Одне натискання — і довірені люди отримують сигнал із геолокацією, фото, відео та звуком. Ми будуємо продукт, яким користуються щодня, і від якості інтерфейсу тут залежить не просто конверсія, а те, чи спрацює застосунок у критичний момент.

Зараз активно ростемо: нові фічі виходять щотижня, працюємо над воронкою, підпискою та розширенням продукту на нові платформи.

Кого шукаємо:
Продуктового дизайнера рівня Middle+ / Senior, який фокусується на мобільних інтерфейсах, розуміє платформні гайдлайни і вміє доводити фічу від задачі до готового макета без нескінченних ітерацій.

Що потрібно робити:
Проєктувати екрани та флоу мобільного застосунку (iOS та Android) — від первинного онбордингу до складних сценаріїв усередині продукту
Працювати з дизайн-системою: підтримувати, розширювати, тримати консистентність
Готувати макети до розробки: стани, граничні випадки, адаптація під різні розміри екранів
Проєктувати підписочні екрани та воронки (пейволи, онбординг-квізи) — з фокусом на конверсію
Час від часу — веб (лендинги, вебворонки) та графіка (сторові скріншоти, банери для реклами, промо-візуали)
Працювати в парі з продактом і розробниками: обговорювати рішення, а не просто виконувати ТЗ

Що для нас важливо:
Портфоліо з мобільними продуктами — саме застосунки, не тільки концепти з Dribbble
Впевнене володіння Figma: компоненти, варіанти, автолейаут, прототипи
Уміння думати сценаріями, а не окремими екранами: що бачить людина, коли немає інтернету, немає даних, немає дозволів
Уважність до деталей: відступи, стани, поведінка при скролі — те, що зазвичай ламається на продакшені
Самостійність: ти отримуєш задачу і повертаєшся з рішенням, а не з питанням «а як зробити?»

Буде плюсом
Досвід із підписочними продуктами та A/B-тестами інтерфейсів
Робота з анімацією (Lottie, Rive) або розуміння моушену
Досвід у продуктах, пов'язаних із безпекою, здоров'ям або сімейними сценаріями

Що пропонуємо
Повністю віддалена робота, гнучкий графік
Продукт, а не аутсорс: ти бачиш, як твої рішення впливають на метрики
Швидкі цикли — від ідеї до релізу тижні, а не квартали
Пряма комунікація з продактом і засновниками, без бюрократії

Як відгукнутися:

title: Web designer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Web Designer who combines strong visual craft and product thinking to design high-converting web experiences that drive measurable acquisition results. You will join our cross-functional acquisition team alongside product managers, product analysts, and developers, where modern web design directly shapes how potential users discover our product and convert into registered users. You will also collaborate closely with marketing designers to integrate brand illustrations, photography, and visual assets across web surfaces.
In this role, you will design and optimize our key acquisition surfaces (websites, landing pages, and registration flows), conduct qualitative research to understand visitor behavior, and translate insights into design improvements. You will set the visual direction for our web presence, influence design decisions, shape the product experience, and deliver measurable results for both the people who use our product and the company.

Responsibilities
Design and evolve our key company websites with strong visual craft, with hand-off to WordPress developers for our main sites and to frontend developers for custom-built landings
Design and continuously optimize registration and authentication flows (social logins via Google, Apple, and similar) within the existing product design system, focusing on reducing drop-off and improving completion rates
Build user flow maps and user journey maps to visualize and improve the acquisition experience end to end
Conduct qualitative user research, including session recording analysis, heatmap reviews, user interviews, and usability testing, to uncover insights and inform design decisions
Create app store creatives, including screenshots, feature graphics, and listing assets for App Store and Google Play
Compose visually compelling layouts with strong typography, hierarchy, and visual rhythm
Collaborate with marketing designers and other creative team members to integrate brand illustrations, photography, and visual assets into web layouts
Adapt designs for multiple regions and languages, ensuring layouts, typography, and content systems work effectively across different markets and locales
Ensure accessibility and responsiveness across different devices, adhering to brand guidelines and the product design system
Document design decisions and guidelines for accurate implementation

Requirements
4+ years of experience designing landing pages, marketing websites, and registration flows
Background that includes hands-on work with conversion metrics, A/B tests, qualitative research, and cross-functional collaboration with product managers and analysts
Portfolio with recent (last 1 to 2 years) landing pages, marketing websites, home pages and registration flows demonstrating modern visual craft and conversion-focused thinking
Strong visual design skills (typography, color theory, layout, hierarchy, composition) with a clear sense of modern web design trends and references
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for visual design, asset preparation, and image editing
Hands-on experience improving registration and sign-up flows by identifying friction through qualitative research and shipping iterative improvements
Experience designing for acquisition, growth, or conversion-focused contexts with measurable impact
Good qualitative research skills, including session recording analysis, heatmap interpretation, user interviews, and usability testing, with the ability to translate observations into actionable design hypotheses
Proficiency in building user flow maps and user journey maps to visualize and communicate complex flows
Experience creating app store creatives (screenshots, feature graphics, listing assets) for App Store and Google Play, with familiarity with ASO visual best practices
Practical experience designing for both WordPress (page builders like Elementor or Gutenberg, reusable block patterns, dynamic content) and custom frontend hand-off, with basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for effective collaboration with developers across both stacks
Proficiency in designing responsive user interfaces for web and mobile, grounded in user-centered design principles and information architecture
Experience working within established design systems (components, tokens, guidelines) and proficiency in Figma for prototyping and rapid iteration
Experience designing for multi-language and multi-regional products, with understanding of how localization affects layout, typography, content density, and visual hierarchy
Proficient English skills (B2+ level) both written and spoken, with strong communication, teamwork, and a user-focused mindset with attention to detail

Will be a plus
Experience working with FinTech products
Illustration skills, with the ability to create custom illustrations or thoughtfully compose layouts using existing illustration assets
Experience designing gamification mechanics
Experience creating microinteractions and lightweight UI animations (Lottie, After Effects, Rive, or similar tools)
Experience using AI-powered tools (Midjourney, Krea, Runway, Figma AI plugins, Claude, or similar) in your design workflow

20 paid vacation days per year
10 paid sick leave days per year
Public holidays as per the company's approved Public holiday list
Medical insurance
Opportunity to work remotely
Professional education budget
Language learning budget
Wellness budget (gym membership, sports gear and related expenses)

You’ll work across a wide range of brand-related projects — from digital campaigns and advertising materials to merchandise, events, and physical brand spaces. We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond individual layouts and understands how to build and evolve a cohesive visual language.

Strong understanding of how to build a cohesive visual system and scale it across different formats and brand touchpoints.
Strong visual culture and design awareness, with a good understanding of current trends in design, typography, composition, and digital and offline communications.

A strong and relevant portfolio demonstrating branding, visual identity, and communication projects.
Experience working across both digital and offline formats, including websites, social media, advertising, merchandise, exhibition stands, and other brand materials.
Strong understanding of brand consistency and the ability to maintain a recognizable visual language across different audiences, formats, and business objectives.

Attention to detail and the ability to work within an established visual identity while also identifying opportunities to evolve it.

Unlimited vacation days and paid sick leave—because your rest matters.
A competitive compensation that truly reflects your skills and expertise.

description:
Median Group — міжнародна компанія, яка розвиває три основні напрямки: онлайн-реклама, навчання студентів та розробка технологічних продуктів.
Ми працюємо з міжнародними проєктами та клієнтами, серед яких Depositphotos, M1, Binotel, Eurovision Ukraine, Concert.ua, Ecoisme, Parimatch, Sweet.tv, MacPaw та інші.

Зараз ми шукаємо Graphic Designer, який/яка допоможе створювати рекламні креативи, тестувати нові візуальні підходи та разом із командою знаходити рішення, які впливають на результати рекламних кампаній.

Функціональні обов'язки

1. Розробка рекламних креативів
Створення концепцій та візуальних рішень для рекламних оголошень.
Розробка статичних та адаптивних креативів під різні рекламні формати.
Тестування різних візуальних підходів та креативних гіпотез.
Адаптація креативів під різні платформи, аудиторії та формати.

2. Робота з креативними гіпотезами та аналітикою
Спільна робота з PPC-командою над формуванням креативних гіпотез.
Участь у плануванні тестів рекламних матеріалів.
Аналіз ефективності креативів та пошук можливостей для їх покращення.
Використання даних рекламних кампаній для створення нових візуальних рішень.

3. Робота з командою
Отримання та уточнення технічних завдань.
Участь у креативних мітах, генерація ідей та пропозицій щодо покращення.
Взаємодія з PPC-спеціалістами, Team Lead та іншими учасниками команди.
Дотримання дедлайнів та погоджених форматів.

4. Організація процесу виробництва та зберігання матеріалів
Структурування створених креативів у загальній системі зберігання.
Підтримка актуальної бази креативів та зручної навігації для команди.
Оновлення версій та архівування застарілих матеріалів.
Участь у створенні бази знань щодо креативів та рішень із використанням AI.

Вимоги до кандидата
Досвід роботи Graphic Designer / Creative Designer від 1 року.
Досвід створення креативів саме для digital-реклами буде перевагою.
Розуміння принципів композиції, типографіки, кольору та візуальної ієрархії.
Вміння працювати з ТЗ та самостійно пропонувати креативні рішення.
Досвід створення креативів для Meta Ads, Google Ads та інших digital-каналів.
Впевнене володіння графічними редакторами.
Англійська мова — Intermediate або вище.

Буде плюсом
Досвід роботи з рекламними креативами та performance marketing.
Розуміння метрик та принципів оцінки ефективності креативів.
Досвід роботи з AI-інструментами для генерації зображень, відео та креативів.
Досвід роботи з Envato.
Досвід роботи з HeyGen.
Досвід роботи з Higgsfield AI.
Досвід роботи з іншими AI-інструментами для створення фото/відео.
Навички motion design та відеомонтажу.

Очікуваний результат роботи
Своєчасне створення якісних рекламних креативів.
Регулярне тестування нових креативних гіпотез.
Створення візуальних рішень, які допомагають покращувати результати рекламних кампаній.
Дотримання дедлайнів та технічних вимог.
Систематизована база рекламних матеріалів.
Активна участь у креативному процесі та генерації нових ідей.
Якісна комунікація з командою.

Ми пропонуємо
Фіксовану оплату + бонуси — можливість впливати на свій дохід.
Повністю віддалену роботу.
Можливість професійного та кар'єрного зростання.
Роботу з міжнародними проєктами та різними нішами.
Доступ до сучасних AI-інструментів для створення контенту.
Оплачувану відпустку 24 робочі дні та державні вихідні.
Можливості навчання та професійного розвитку.
Відсутність зайвої бюрократії та мікроменеджменту.
Корпоративні заходи та командні активності.

Чекаємо на твій відгук, якщо хочеш створювати креативи, які не просто виглядають круто, а й дають результат 🚀

title: Graphic Designer for a Marketing Agency (US-based/Remote)
description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

We are hiring a high-level Graphic Designer with a strong focus on AI-driven creative workflows. This is not a traditional execution-only design role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, direct AI tools effectively, and produce polished, high-end creative across multiple surfaces. A significant portion of this role involves prompt engineering, AI asset generation, and refinement into production-ready designs using professional tools.

You will be responsible for creating a wide range of internal creative assets, including:

* Ad creatives (primarily performance-focused)
* High-fidelity website assets
* Branding elements
* Product imagery

Work will vary day-to-day. Some days may be focused on ad creative development, while others may involve website graphics or brand asset creation.

*Responsibilities:*

* Generate high-quality visual concepts using AI platforms (Claude, Gemini, and others)
* Apply prompt engineering techniques to control output quality, style, and consistency
* Design creatives that align with a clean, modern biotech aesthetic
* Contribute to both creative direction and execution
* Collaborate internally to iterate on concepts and improve output quality
* Stay current with emerging AI tools and continuously improve workflows
* Refine and elevate AI-generated assets using:

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Figma

*Requirements*

* Strong experience with:

* Adobe Suite
* Figma
* Gemini
* Claude

* Demonstrated experience using AI tools for design workflows (Claude, Gemini, etc.)
* Strong prompt engineering ability (not just basic usage)
* Solid understanding of:

* Layout and composition
* Typography
* Visual hierarchy

* Ability to take rough/generated assets and bring them to a high-end, production-ready standard
* Excellent English communication skills
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

*We are specifically looking for someone who can:*

* Leverage AI as a tool, not a crutch
* Control output quality through prompting and refinement
* Deliver clean, modern, high-trust creative aligned with a biotech aesthetic

*Benefits*

* Fully remote
* Contractor role (global)

title: Motion/Graphic Designer (iGaming)
description:
Шукаємо Motion & Graphic Designer, який вміє перетворювати ідеї на креативи, а креативи — на результат.
Ти працюватимеш у тісній зв’язці з media buying-командою, створюватимеш візуали для Facebook Ads та in-app трафіку, тестуватимеш нові підходи та швидко адаптуватимеш креативи на основі результатів рекламних кампаній.
Для нас важливий не просто красивий дизайн — нам потрібна людина, яка розуміє, як візуал впливає на CTR, CR та ефективність реклами.

Що потрібно буде робити
Створювати статичні та динамічні рекламні креативи для performance- та affiliate-кампаній.
Розробляти motion-креативи: короткі відео, анімовані банери, тизери, лупи та інші динамічні формати.
Створювати статичні банери, сторіс, прев’ю та графіку для лендингів, застосунків і промо.
Адаптувати та унікалізувати креативи під різні формати, GEO та рекламні майданчики.
Швидко доопрацьовувати та оновлювати креативи за результатами тестів.
Працювати разом із media buyers над пошуком нових візуальних концепцій та підходів.
Брати участь у формуванні та розвитку візуального стилю продуктів.
Використовувати AI-інструменти для пришвидшення роботи, пошуку ідей та експериментів із візуалом.

Що для нас важливо
2+ роки досвіду у графічному та/або motion-дизайні.
Досвід у performance, affiliate або iGaming буде великою перевагою.
Впевнене володіння After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator або аналогами.
Хороше знання Figma.
AI-інструменти — частина твого робочого процесу, а не просто щось, що ти пробував.
Розуміння специфіки рекламних креативів для Facebook та in-app.
Хороше відчуття композиції, динаміки, типографіки та візуальної ієрархії.
Готовність працювати в режимі швидких ітерацій та постійного тестування.
Базове розуміння performance-метрик: CTR, CPA, CR та того, як креатив може на них впливати.
Уміння сприймати дизайн не лише як візуальне завдання, а як інструмент для досягнення бізнес-результату.

Що ми пропонуємо
Повністю віддалений формат роботи.
Конкурентну оплату — обговорюємо індивідуально залежно від досвіду.
Роботу в сильній команді у сфері iGaming / performance marketing.
Пряму взаємодію з media buyers та можливість бачити, як твої креативи працюють у реальних рекламних кампаніях.
Багато простору для тестів, експериментів та власних ідей.
Швидкі процеси та мінімум зайвої бюрократії.
Можливість професійно розвиватися разом із командою та впливати на візуальний напрямок продуктів.

Якщо тобі цікаво не просто створювати дизайн, а робити креативи, які реально впливають на рекламні показники — будемо раді познайомитися.

Leading Recruitment at THG Ingenuity | Build World-Class E-Commerce Tech & Global SaaS Solutions

About THG
THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment. Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor & Gamble.Technology is the driving force behind THG Ingenuity, and it starts with our people. We are ambitious with our goals and challenge conventional thinking. THG Ingenuity is different because we support every single person to make massive impact and drive their own work. Our people are always learning, and we work every day to ensure our technology, from our software platforms to our hosting services, to our AIcapability and beyond, is world class. This enables us to keep powering THG Ingenuity and our partners on a global scale.

About the Team
You will join one of the largest AI teams in retail and e‑commerce, operating at global scale across the full retail stack — from on‑site product discovery and personalisation, through to demand forecasting, pricing, fraud prevention, and warehouse fulfilment. We work across every modality (tabular, text, image, video) and combine classical techniques with state‑of‑the‑art deep learning, NLP, generative AI, and agentic systems to ship solutions that are sustainable, optimised, and commercially valuable.
We are an AI‑first team. That means we don’t just build AI products — we build with AI. AI design and coding tools are a core part of how our designers and engineers work, and we expect everyone on the team to use them well: to move faster, raise the quality of the work, and spend more time on the problems that genuinely require human judgement.
UX Designers in the AI & Data team sit at the intersection of product, design, and machine learning. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and commercial stakeholders to shape AI‑powered experiences that go straight into production for customers and operators across our retail and e‑commerce estate.

The Role
As a UX Designer in the AI & Data team, you will own the end‑to‑end experience of the AI‑powered web applications we ship — from early discovery and user research, through information architecture, interaction design, and visual design, to validating the work with real users and supporting engineering through implementation. You will design interfaces that make generative and agentic systems feel intuitive, trustworthy, and fast, and you will be hands‑on enough to either prototype in code or run the testing that proves your designs work.
This is a hands‑on, generalist UX role with a deliberate technical lean. You will spend most of your time in Figma — building flows, wireframes, prototypes, and a living design system — but you will also work side‑by‑side with engineers shipping a Next.js, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui front end, and you will be expected to either contribute directly to the front‑end implementation (HTML/CSS/JS, ideally React) or to run the usability research and testing that closes the loop on every release. You will use AI design and coding tools fluently as part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities
- Own end‑to‑end UX. Take features from discovery through user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and final visual design — aligned to product timelines and quality bars.
- Design for AI and agentic experiences. Make generative outputs, long‑running tasks, streaming responses, human‑in‑the‑loop review, and agent state legible to users; design for failure, uncertainty, and recoverability.
- Run user research and usability testing. Plan and run moderated and unmoderated sessions, synthesise findings, and translate insight into design decisions you can defend with evidence.
- Contribute to the front end. Either pair closely with engineers on Next.js, React, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui implementations — reviewing PRs and tightening interaction, motion, and accessibility — or pick up component‑level front‑end tickets yourself.
- Build and maintain the design system. Curate tokens, components, and patterns in Figma and keep them in lockstep with the implemented Tailwind/shadcn/ui library so design and code stay in sync.
- Get accessibility right. Ship interfaces that meet WCAG 2.2 AA as a baseline — semantic structure, keyboard support, focus management, contrast, and screen‑reader behaviour — and test them.
- Design with data. Use product analytics, session replay, and qualitative research together to prioritise the right problems and measure whether the work landed.
- Design with AI. Use AI design and prototyping tools (Figma AI, v0, Galileo, Uizard, Magic Patterns, or similar) and AI assistants for research synthesis as a default part of your workflow, and help the team adopt these practices responsibly.
- Partner with stakeholders. Translate ambiguous product asks into well‑defined design work, and communicate trade‑offs and rationale in clear, non‑design language.
- Raise the craft bar. Champion design reviews, critique, documentation, and internal knowledge‑sharing across designers, PMs, and engineers.

What We’re Looking For
Essential
- BA, BSc, MA, MSc, or equivalent in Design, Human–Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Cognitive Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience.
- Three or more years designing and shipping production web or SaaS products end‑to‑end, with a clear track record of owning features from discovery to release.
- Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design across complex, data‑rich web applications — not just marketing surfaces.
- Either (a) hands‑on front‑end development experience — semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript, and ideally a component framework such as React (Next.js a plus) and a utility CSS framework such as Tailwind — comfortable shipping component‑level code or pairing with engineers on implementation; or (b) demonstrable usability testing and user research experience — planning and running moderated and unmoderated studies, recruiting participants, synthesising findings, and feeding insight back into design and product decisions. Candidates strong in both will be prioritised.
- Expert‑level Figma skills — auto layout, variables, variants, prototyping, and contributing to a shared design system used by engineering.
- Solid grasp of design‑system thinking — tokens, components, patterns, and the lifecycle of keeping a Figma library in sync with an implemented component library.
- Demonstrable experience designing for accessibility against WCAG 2.2 AA and reasoning about keyboard, focus, contrast, and screen‑reader behaviour from the design stage.
- AI‑first mindset and hands‑on experience with AI design, prototyping, and assistant tools (Figma AI, v0, Galileo, Uizard, Magic Patterns, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of your daily workflow. You should be able to describe, with concrete examples, how you use AI to explore, draft, critique, and validate design work — and how you manage its limitations.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Product Managers, Engineers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and commercial stakeholders.

Desirable
- Experience designing for AI, generative, or agentic products — long‑running tasks, streaming outputs, tool use, multi‑step plans, evaluation, and human‑in‑the‑loop review.
- Working knowledge of a modern React stack — Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix UI primitives — sufficient to read code and ship UI tickets.
- Experience working in or alongside a multi‑tenant SaaS product, including tenant‑aware UX, role‑based access, and workspace‑level personalisation.
- Experience running quantitative research — A/B testing, surveys, funnel and behavioural analytics — with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, Hotjar, FullStory, or Maze.
- Experience with motion, micro‑interactions, and prototyping in tools such as Framer, Origami, ProtoPie, or Rive.
- Exposure to retail or e‑commerce production systems: product discovery, search and ranking, recommendations, personalisation, merchandising, pricing, or fulfilment operator tools.
- Experience contributing to or maintaining a public design system, component library, or design‑engineering documentation site.
- Open‑source contributions, a public design portfolio with case studies, or published writing on design practice.

About The Company

Data Eminence is a forward-thinking technology company dedicated to delivering innovative digital solutions that empower businesses and enhance user experiences. Our mission is to harness the power of data and design to create impactful products that meet the evolving needs of our clients. With a focus on quality, creativity, and user-centric development, Data Eminence has established a reputation for excellence in the tech industry. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where talented professionals can thrive, learn, and contribute to cutting-edge projects that make a difference in the digital landscape.

About The Role

Join Data Eminence as a remote UI/UX Designer and help create intuitive, attractive, and user-friendly digital experiences. You'll work on user research, wireframes, prototypes, interfaces, and design systems while collaborating with product and engineering teams. Ideal for creative candidates with a strong understanding of user-centered design, this role offers an exciting opportunity to influence the look and feel of our digital products. As a key member of our design team, you will translate complex ideas into simple, engaging interfaces that enhance user satisfaction and engagement.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, or a related field. We are seeking individuals with 0-2 years of experience in UI/UX design or relevant internships, demonstrating a strong foundation in design principles. Proficiency in design tools such as Figma or similar platforms is essential. Candidates should have experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and user flows, along with a good understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy. An understanding of responsive and mobile-first design, as well as basic accessibility principles, is required. Strong communication and presentation skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote setting are also key qualifications for this role.

Responsibilities

The UI/UX Designer at Data Eminence will be responsible for a variety of tasks aimed at creating seamless digital experiences. Key responsibilities include conducting user research and gathering feedback to inform design decisions, creating user flows, wireframes, and prototypes that effectively communicate design ideas, and designing responsive web and mobile interfaces that adapt across devices. The role also involves developing high-fidelity UI designs, maintaining and evolving design systems and reusable components, and collaborating closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs. Additionally, the designer will conduct usability testing, identify usability and accessibility issues, and incorporate user feedback to refine interfaces. Creating comprehensive design documentation and specifications, working with product teams to understand business and user requirements, and staying updated with current UI/UX trends and best practices are integral parts of this position.

Benefits

Data Eminence offers a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefits program. As a fully remote organization, we provide flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance. Employees enjoy paid time off and holidays, enabling them to recharge and maintain productivity. We are committed to professional growth and development, offering opportunities for training, workshops, and certifications. The company also provides necessary equipment to facilitate remote work. Working at Data Eminence means participating in innovative projects with modern digital products, gaining valuable experience in a dynamic and supportive environment.

Equal Opportunity

Data Eminence is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring process is based on merit, skills, and experience, and we strive to provide equal opportunities for growth and advancement to all team members.

title: CAD Design Intern
description:
This is a remote position.

*Remote CAD Design Intern (India)*

*Company:* Trustbridge Engineering, a Division of Vulcury LLC

*Location:* Remote (Candidates from India Preferred)

*Internship Duration:* 12 Weeks (Potential for Full-Time Opportunity Based on Performance)

*About Us:*

Trustbridge Engineering, part of Vulcury LLC, provides expert support in design and manufacturing for clients across industrial, consumer, automotive, aerospace, and medical sectors. Led by an engineer based in India, our team focuses on transforming client concepts into manufacturable designs. This internship offers valuable hands-on experience, working with clients and contributing to impactful projects.

*Position Summary:*

We are seeking a Remote CAD Design Intern to work closely with our Head Engineer on diverse client projects and internal initiatives. This role is a 12-week paid internship, with the opportunity for full-time employment for outstanding performers. This is a late-day India shift, starting in the afternoon to allow some overlap with US working hours. Candidates with experience in design and an understanding of various manufacturing processes are particularly attractive, as this knowledge is useful when optimizing designs for manufacturability and engaging with manufacturers.

*Responsibilities:*

* Collaborate with the Head Engineer to develop and refine 2D and 3D CAD models and drawings.

* Use software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, ANSYS, and Fusion 360 to create designs across various sectors.

* Optimize designs for manufacturability, ensuring they align with different manufacturing processes.

* Support internal initiatives related to referring clients to appropriate manufacturers, including supplier research and analysis.

* Prepare design presentations and technical documentation for client projects.

* Participate in client meetings as required to understand project goals and present design updates.

*Internship Structure:*

* *12 Weeks:* Paid internship with ongoing performance reviews.

* *Post-Internship:* Opportunity for a full-time role based on outstanding performance.

*What We Offer:*

* Real-world design experience in a dynamic engineering environment.

* Mentorship from experienced professionals and exposure to complex design and manufacturing challenges.

* A potential pathway to full-time employment for high-performing interns.

If you're passionate about design, manufacturing processes, and ready for a growth opportunity, apply now to join Trustbridge Engineering!

Job Types: Internship, Contract

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

* CAD: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

Requirements
------------

**Qualifications:**

* *Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field.*

* *At least 6 months of hands-on experience with 2D and 3D modeling.*

* *Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, ANSYS, or Fusion 360.*

* *Understanding of how design choices interact with various manufacturing processes is highly desirable.*

* *Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.*

* *Effective communication skills for remote collaboration.*

* *Past client experience is a plus, though not required.*

**Requirements:**

title: Multimedia Designer
description:
About Nexford
Nexford University is a next-generation online university built for a fast-changing world providing flexible, affordable, career-relevant education for ambitious, globally minded learners.

About the Marketing Team

Nexford’s marketing team is modern, ambitious, and built to move. We combine sharp strategy, strong creative, performance data, marketing technology, and AI-assisted workflows to create campaigns that are both culturally relevant and commercially effective. We value people who bring ideas, take ownership, collaborate openly, and care about the details that turn good creative into great creative.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Multimedia Designer based in the Philippines to help bring Nexford’s brand and campaigns to life across static, motion, and video formats. This is a hands-on role for a versatile emerging designer who understands how creative needs to work across channels, not just look good in a portfolio.

You’ll work closely with creative, copy, demand generation, marketing operations, and web teammates to translate briefs into polished, production-ready assets. You should be comfortable working within an established brand system while bringing fresh thinking, strong taste, and a genuine curiosity about what makes modern marketing creative perform.

What You'll Do

* Design static and motion assets for paid/organic social, email, and display
* Edit and produce short-form video basic motion graphics, animation, captions, text treatments
* Build and adapt on-brand templates in Figma and Canva
* Support web/landing page assets
* Develop creative variations for testing, then use performance feedback to sharpen future work
* Keep source files and assets organized so the team can find, reuse, and scale them
* Juggle multiple requests and deadlines while staying current on social-first trends

What You Bring

* 2–4 yrs in graphic/multimedia design (internship, freelance, in-house all count)
* Strong Figma and Canva; working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and/or After Effects
* A portfolio showing strong fundamentals (typography, layout, color, hierarchy) across social, digital, and multimedia
* Clean short-form video and basic motion graphics
* Ability to take a brief to polished work independently, and ask smart questions when direction is thin
* Openness to feedback, iteration, and collaborative critique

Nice to Have

* Edtech, SaaS, higher-ed, or tech-forward brand experience
* Responsible use of AI tools to speed ideation, production, and versioning
* Short-form video fluency (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)
* Paid media / performance creative exposure

How We Work

We move quickly, but quality still matters. You’ll be trusted to take ownership of assigned work, communicate early when something is unclear or at risk, and respond constructively to feedback. We care about creative judgment, reliability, curiosity, and continuous improvement. You do not need to know everything on day one, but you should be ready to learn fast and contribute with intention.

Nexford University is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds , identities, experiences, and perspectives who are excited to help build the future of education.

description:
This is not your typical internship. There are no coffee runs, no busywork, and no fighting 200 other applicants for one spot.

GWEN is an AI-powered UX internship where you work on real-world design projects with AI teammates and a mentor. You'll build portfolio-ready case studies, get detailed feedback on your work, and receive a reference letter on completion.

Upfront, because it matters: This is a paid training programme, not employment. The job interview and your first project are free. The full internship is a one-time $199, and regional pricing applies automatically in lower-income countries.

*How it works:*

*

Pass a simulated job interview, then start your first project the same day

*

Your first project is free: tear down a real client's signup flow with your mentor, redesign it, and get both screens reviewed

*

Work through 7 structured UX projects at your own pace, from anywhere

*

Collaborate with AI teammates who challenge your thinking and give real-time feedback

*

Build portfolio pieces you can actually show employers

There is no salary and no job offer at the end. What you get is practice, feedback and proof of work: the three things every junior UX application is missing.

A laptop or desktop (the internship doesn't run on phones)

Interest in UX design (student, fresher, graduate)

Self-motivated and able to work independently

Willingness to learn, take feedback, and build something you're proud of

Reference letter at completion, certificate and a portfolio review on request. Pay once, keep lifetime access including future projects.

This freelance opportunity is designed for an experienced graphic designer who wants to help shape the next generation of AI-powered creative tools. You will apply your expertise in visual communication, composition, typography, color, and creative direction to evaluate AI-generated design content. Your feedback will help models better understand professional design principles across digital and print formats. You’ll work remotely and collaborate with a team focused on improving model outputs, prompts, and evaluation standards. * Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, quality criteria, and design guidelines used for AI training.

* Ability to clearly articulate why a design works or does not work and translate creative judgment into precise written feedback.
* Strong understanding of both digital and print design principles and workflows.
* Experience with *Adobe XD or Figma* for UI/UX-related design is an advantage.
* Familiarity with *After Effects or Premiere Pro* and motion graphics is a plus.
* Additional experience in social media content creation, video editing, illustration, or photography is beneficial.
* Excellent written communication, independent judgment, attention to detail, and ability to work accurately on repetitive evaluation tasks.
* Comfortable working with AI tools and adapting professional design expertise to model evaluation and training workflows.
* Mid-senior level design experience and the ability to work independently in a fully remote freelance environment.
* Ability to provide your own secure computer and reliable, high-speed internet connection.

--------
Benefits

* Flexible freelance, contract-based opportunity with fully remote work.
* Opportunity to apply professional graphic design expertise to the development of next-generation AI systems.
* Work directly on projects involving advanced language and vision models and AI-generated visual content.

title: Freelance Presentation Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do
----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
* Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
* Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
* Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
* Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started
------------------

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
* Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
* Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
* Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

*Additional requirements*

* Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
* Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.*

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$34 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

We are seeking a talented UX Designer to join our team and contribute to the design of user experiences for our global Pattern fulfillment network. This role involves creating interfaces for receiving, tracking, auditing, shipping inventory and more. Our integrated data, software, and processes are designed to provide the scalability, accuracy, and speed necessary to support the diverse needs of both our full-service brand partners and 3PL customers. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, and business leaders, to develop new capabilities that advance this vision across both existing and new services.

What is a day in the life of a UX Designer?

-  Effectively communicate problems and solutions through strong verbal and written communication.
-  Collaborate closely with product and development teams to uncover key insights that drive business and product success.
-  Participate in cross-functional design critiques with other designers across Pattern.
-  Define, document, and present design requirements.
-  Create experiences using our in-house design system and propose enhancements.
-  Ensure continuity and quality of the product experience.
-  Continuously develop expert understanding of worldwide e-commerce marketplaces and their supporting logistics.
-  Stay informed on the competitive landscape and apply these insights appropriately.

Technical Qualificaion

-  Bachelor's degree in HCI, Visual Design, Industrial Design, Psychology, or other related degree
-  In depth knowledge of UX related responsibilities and how to act on them
-  Moderate to expert understanding of Figma
-  Understanding of when to leverage one’s own experience, seek out leadership/stakeholder expertise
-  Experience with using AI tools to expedite the appropriate steps in the UX process.

What does high performance look like?

-  You take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion
-  You clearly communicate questions or concerns as soon as they arise
-  You take initiative to understand and proactively tackle challenges that come your way

What is my potential for career growth?

This role offers significant opportunities to improve and streamline operations and finance within Pattern. As we optimize existing processes and develop new services for current and future partners, the scope of responsibility for each UX professional will expand considerably.

What is the team like?

This role, within our Operations and Finance organization, involves close collaboration with a skilled team of Product Managers and Engineers to develop world-class products. We prioritize creating solutions that are both impactful and engaging. The team operates with a data-driven and results-oriented approach, regularly collaborating with cross-functional members to implement actionable solutions. All team members are encouraged to contribute ideas and input.

Pattern is a leading eCommerce data and growth company located in the Silicon Slopes tech hub with global offices in Europe, China, Australia, the Middle East, and Canada. Some of the biggest consumer brands like Skullcandy, Nestle, Clorox, Kong, Panasonic, Tumi, and PopSockets trust Pattern with their business. Pattern has recruited talent from brands like Amazon, eBay, Adobe, Pepsico, Apple, Google, and Oracle.

About The Company

Data Eminence is a forward-thinking technology company dedicated to delivering innovative digital solutions that empower businesses and enhance user experiences. With a focus on data-driven strategies and cutting-edge design, Data Eminence strives to create impactful products that meet the evolving needs of clients across various industries. Our team comprises passionate professionals committed to excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. We foster a dynamic remote work environment that encourages creativity, flexibility, and professional growth, making Data Eminence an ideal place for talented individuals to thrive and contribute to transformative digital projects.

About The Role

Join Data Eminence as a remote UI/UX Designer and help create intuitive, attractive, and user-friendly digital experiences. You'll work on user research, wireframes, prototypes, interfaces, and design systems while collaborating with product and engineering teams. This role is perfect for creative candidates with a strong understanding of user-centered design principles who are eager to develop engaging and accessible digital products. As part of our growing team, you will have the opportunity to influence the look and feel of our products, ensuring they are both aesthetically pleasing and highly functional.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess a bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, or a related field. Prior experience in UI/UX design, internships included, is preferred but not mandatory, with 0-2 years of relevant experience. A strong understanding of core UI and UX principles is essential, along with proficiency in design tools such as Figma or similar platforms. Candidates should have experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and user flows, along with a good grasp of typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy. An understanding of responsive and mobile-first design is necessary, as well as basic knowledge of accessibility standards. Excellent communication and presentation skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote setting are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

The UI/UX Designer at Data Eminence will be responsible for a variety of tasks aimed at delivering high-quality digital experiences. Key responsibilities include conducting user research and gathering feedback to inform design decisions. Creating user flows, wireframes, and prototypes to visualize concepts and test usability. Designing responsive web and mobile interfaces that adapt seamlessly across devices. Developing high-fidelity UI designs that align with brand standards and project requirements. Building and maintaining design systems and reusable components to ensure consistency across products. Collaborating closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and functionalities. Conducting usability testing to identify issues and incorporating feedback to improve user experience. Addressing usability and accessibility challenges to create inclusive digital products. Documenting design specifications and guidelines for development teams. Working with product managers and stakeholders to understand business goals and user needs. Staying updated on the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and best practices to continuously enhance design quality and innovation.

Benefits

At Data Eminence, we value our team members and offer a comprehensive benefits package to support their professional and personal growth. Employees receive a competitive salary aligned with industry standards. Our fully remote work environment provides flexibility to balance work and life commitments. We offer paid time off and holidays to ensure adequate rest and rejuvenation. Opportunities for professional development include training programs, workshops, and access to industry resources. The company provides necessary equipment to facilitate a productive remote workspace. Additionally, team members have the chance to work on cutting-edge digital products, gaining valuable experience in modern design workflows and tools.

Equal Opportunity

Data Eminence is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse teams foster innovation and creativity, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Our hiring process is fair and transparent, aimed at selecting the best talent to contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional digital solutions.

Design is one of the key roles in our organisation. This is how our users will experience our products, and we are obsessed with giving them the best visual experience by shipping beautiful products across all channels - App, Web, and others included.

Visual Design at Raise is the custodian of our brand identity across every touchpoint - Product, Apps, Web, Social Media, and both online & offline experiences. As a Visual Designer, you will design a wide range of visual experiences across digital and offline platforms. To succeed in this role, you should be a self-starter with a strong ability to craft compelling visual stories, illustrations, and brand-led experiences, along with a sharp eye for detail.

You will be responsible for creating engaging, intuitive, and visually rich experiences that enhance how users interact with our brand across apps, web, and campaigns. Experience in building visual narratives from scratch and simplifying complex user journeys in consumer products or startups will be a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities:
Visual & Illustration Design
- Create illustrations, icons, and visual assets for product and marketing.
- Design app icons, in-product graphics, and visual elements that enhance UX.

Social & Marketing Assets
- Design high-quality creatives for social media, campaigns, and growth initiatives.
- Work on quick-turnaround visuals while maintaining quality and consistency.
Product Collaboration
- Work closely with product and design teams to integrate visuals into the app and web experience.

Design Consistency
- Maintain visual consistency across all outputs — product, social, and brand.

- Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, etc.).

- Understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and modern design styles.
- Comfortable working on fast iterations and multiple formats.
Add On (Good to Have):

- Experience with Video Editing for social media
- Exposure to fintech, consumer apps, or product-led companies

We’re a certified Great Place to Work, and it shows in everything we do - from how we collaborate to how we celebrate wins. Our culture is built on growth, ownership, and mutual respect. Our Values & Culture

- Are obsessed with customer satisfaction.

- Value speed, humility, and thoughtful action.
- Prefer quality over quantity.

We are building technology led financial products and infrastructure for India’s top 25Mn+ financially aware and literate users. We will offer consumer products & services that cater to these users, and will offer the same technology & infrastructure to partners in the startup ecosystem willing to take the experience to everyone in India. title: Junior Graphics Designer
location: Remote, Greater Las Vegas Area, NV
description:
About Evo

For over 20 years, The Evolution Championship Series (Evo), has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are rallying points where fans, publishers, developers, and brands celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them. Beyond our established live events, Evo’s mission continues to evolve to create, celebrate, and renew fighting game fandom.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a Junior Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals and a sharp visual sensibility to support the RTS creative team, with a primary focus on presentation and sales materials.

This role will work closely with the RTS sales team to design, refine, and maintain polished presentation decks used for sales meetings, pitches, proposals, and client-facing communications. The ideal candidate is someone who understands how typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, imagery, and visual consistency work together to communicate information clearly and persuasively.

While this is a junior-level role, we're looking for someone who can bring a strong design point of view and a high level of attention to detail to their work. You should be comfortable taking existing content and transforming it into a clean, compelling presentation, while also being able to work within established brand systems and templates.

You will also support Evo and other RTS creative needs, including templated graphics, digital assets, and other design production as needed.

This is an excellent opportunity for a designer early in their career who wants hands-on experience working at the intersection of design, sales, esports, and entertainment, while developing their skills across a range of creative projects.

**Reporting Structure**

You will report to Evo's Creative Director.

**Key Responsibilities**

* RTS Sales & Presentation Design
*

* Design, refine, and maintain presentation decks for RTS sales meetings, pitches, proposals, and other business needs.
* Translate written information, data, and sales messaging into clear, visually compelling presentation layouts.
* Create and maintain presentation templates and deck themes, ensuring consistency across multiple presentations and projects.
* Develop and update slide layouts, visual systems, charts, graphics, and other presentation elements.
* Create mockups and visual representations of proposed campaigns, partnerships, sponsorships, and other client-facing concepts.
* Work closely with the Sales team to understand project goals, incorporate feedback, and adapt presentations to meet specific client or pitch needs.
* Maintain a high level of consistency, polish, and attention to detail across presentation materials.
* Organize and manage presentation assets, templates, and source files so they remain easy to update and reuse.

* Evo & General Creative Support
*

* Support the creative team with design and asset production for Evo events and other RTS projects.
* Create and update templated digital assets, including broadcast graphics, YouTube thumbnails, and other high-volume creative deliverables.
* Adapt existing creative systems and templates to efficiently produce polished, consistent assets.
* Support additional design and production needs as projects and priorities evolve.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of graphic design experience, or equivalent experience through internships, freelance work, personal projects, or other relevant creative work.
* A strong design portfolio demonstrating excellent fundamentals and a thoughtful visual approach.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and the broader Google Workspace/G Suite, including Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive.
* Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, spacing, and general graphic design principles.
* Strong attention to detail and an eye for visual consistency and polish.
* Ability to take complex or information-heavy content and organize it into clear, easy-to-understand visual presentations.
* Ability to work within established brand guidelines while making thoughtful design decisions.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
* Clear and professional communication skills.
* Comfortable receiving feedback, asking questions, and iterating on work.
* Ability to work collaboratively and adapt to the needs of different teams and projects.
* Comfortable working closely with the RTS sales team and responding to evolving project needs and feedback.
* Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask for direction or clarification.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience designing presentation decks, sales materials, proposals, or other client-facing communications.
* Experience creating or maintaining presentation templates and visual systems.
* Experience working with high-volume or templated creative production.
* Familiarity with Figma.
* Knowledge of or interest in esports, fighting games, gaming, or the FGC.
* General familiarity with the esports and gaming industry.

Compensation

The salary for this role is $45,000.00 to $60,000.00 depending on experience.

**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* 401k plan available for employee contributions
* Flexible work schedule
* Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
* Remote-first culture

title: Intern, Graphic Design (52074)

description:
*TO APPLY: Please submit a PORTFOLIO that exhibits proficiency in graphic design principles.*

*WHY JOIN AGU?*

Our employees are our most valuable assets! You will feel welcomed and supported from the moment you join our team, and you will take part in strengthening and evolving our workplace culture.

We offer work-life balance- We are a remote-first organization, with flexible work hours.

*WHO WE ARE?*

The American Geophysical Union (AGU) supports a global community of more than half a million professionals and advocates in the Earth and space sciences.

Through broad and inclusive partnerships, AGU aims to advance discovery and solution science that accelerates knowledge and creates solutions that are ethical, unbiased, and respectful of communities and their values. Our programs include serving as a scholarly publisher, convening virtual and in-person events, and providing career support. We live our values in everything we do, such as our net-zero energy renovated building in Washington, D.C., and our Ethics and Equity Center, which fosters a diverse and inclusive geoscience community to ensure responsible conduct.

This is an exciting time to work at AGU. Every day we approach our work with a sense of purpose, and we look for others who share that passion and desire for a career with impact.

*WHO YOU ARE?*

At AGU we are looking for individuals who want to learn something new every day, who welcome a challenge, and who are motivated to achieve results in a fast-paced environment. You will be a proactive and creative problem solver who enjoys collaborating across diverse teams.You will support the Design & Branding team in the creation of marketing materials, digital graphics, and creative materials.

*WHAT YOU WILL DO*

* Conceptualize, design, execute, and effectively communicate the strategic intent for creative solutions that consistently and clearly communicate AGU’s brand identity, vision, values, and messaging to a variety of critical target audiences.
* Create designs for marketing materials, events, digital properties, social media, and other visual assets to support AGU’s goals, programs, and initiatives.
* Research, develop and design magazine spreads, covers, in-house advertising, and web assets for Eos, AGU’s award-winning monthly news magazine, adhering to established production standards, schedules, deadlines, and budgets.
* Works collaboratively and openly with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department on projects, ensuring that all work meets programmatic goals while following AGU’s brand standards.

*WHAT YOU WILL BRING?*

* A Bachelor's degree in graphic design and/or current student or graduate graphic design program
* Ability to convey complex ideas through imagery and design to support the achievement of key marketing and communications goals.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop and Acrobat, as well as the Microsoft Suite.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects at the same time on a tight deadline.
* Ability to work in a collaborative environment.
* Organizational and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

*HIRING SPECIFICS*

* We understand that it is unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria listed in a job posting. However, we encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve. If you are willing to learn and evolve alongside us, join our team!
* Full Time/ Hourly, 3-month internship, This remote role is open to candidates based in most U.S. states (excluding WA, OR, and CA at this time).
* Pay is $18.40 per hour.
* AGU will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
* Work Authorization: We will not sponsor applicants for work visas in the US.
* We care deeply about fairness so you can be ensured that your application will never be judged based on religious belief, age, color, race, creed, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, political affiliation, ethnic origin, or disability.
* Veterans and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
* We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

title: Designer Gráfico - Sênior | V4 Persona & Co
description:
Na V4 Company, desafiamos o mercado e entregamos resultados reais. O time de Creative Performance tem como missão transformar estratégia em comunicação visual de alta performance, conectando criatividade, dados e objetivos de negócio para impulsionar aquisição, retenção e crescimento de receita.

O Designer Gráfico (Creative Performance) Sênior é a principal referência técnica da vertical de Design dentro da operação. Essa posição conecta criatividade, branding, performance e inovação para desenvolver campanhas de alta complexidade, elevar o padrão das entregas e impulsionar resultados de negócio por meio de soluções visuais estratégicas.

Além de atuar na criação de campanhas de alto impacto, o profissional desempenha papel fundamental na evolução da equipe, disseminando conhecimento, estruturando processos e utilizando Inteligência Artificial para escalar a produção criativa e acelerar a inovação.

Se você possui excelência técnica, visão estratégica e gosta de desenvolver pessoas enquanto cria soluções criativas que geram resultados reais, essa oportunidade é para você! 😎🚀

----------------------------
Sobre o ambiente de trabalho
----------------------------

Somos guiados por atitudes claras e transparentes em nossa rotina, que nos permitem fazer o máximo para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, confiando nas pessoas que estão ao nosso lado.

Aqui ninguém é empregado de ninguém. O ambiente é o mais horizontal possível, proporcionando autonomia para que você tome as melhores decisões dentro das suas responsabilidades. Não espere pelos outros aquilo que você pode fazer por si mesmo.

********************************************************************
Como Designer Gráfico (Creative Performance) Sênior, sua missão será
********************************************************************

Liderar tecnicamente a produção criativa da operação, garantindo que campanhas, identidades visuais e experiências digitais unam excelência estética, estratégia e performance.

Você será responsável por desenvolver criativos de alta complexidade, definir direcionamentos visuais, validar estratégias criativas, utilizar Inteligência Artificial para otimizar processos e atuar como referência técnica para o desenvolvimento dos Designers Júnior e Pleno, fortalecendo a cultura de Creative Performance da V4 Company.

****************************
Principais responsabilidades
****************************

* Desenvolver key visuals, campanhas, landing pages, motions e materiais audiovisuais de alta complexidade para campanhas digitais.
* Estruturar conceitos visuais e estratégias criativas alinhadas aos objetivos de marketing, branding e performance.
* Criar landing pages avançadas aplicando princípios de UX/UI voltados para conversão.
* Produzir animações e vídeos com alto nível técnico e refinamento visual.
* Planejar, executar e interpretar testes A/B e testes multivariáveis para otimização de criativos.
* Analisar dashboards e métricas de performance para orientar decisões criativas baseadas em dados.
* Desenvolver estratégias visuais personalizadas para diferentes segmentos, públicos e objetivos de negócio.
* Validar e ajustar campanhas criativas conforme indicadores de CTR, conversão, retenção e demais métricas estratégicas.
* Utilizar Inteligência Artificial de forma avançada para automação, geração de conceitos, otimização de fluxos e ganho de produtividade.
* Criar fluxos e processos escaláveis utilizando ferramentas de IA, incluindo ComfyUI e outras soluções voltadas à produção criativa.
* Atuar como mentor técnico dos Designers Júnior e Pleno, promovendo feedbacks, desenvolvimento e compartilhamento de boas práticas.
* Realizar auditorias criativas em projetos da categoria Executar, garantindo qualidade técnica e alinhamento estratégico.
* Estruturar frameworks, playbooks e metodologias para padronizar e elevar a qualidade das entregas.
* Colaborar diretamente com as áreas de Tráfego, Copy, Growth e Atendimento na construção de campanhas de alta conversão.
* Contribuir para a evolução da Tribo de Creative Performance, propondo melhorias em processos, ferramentas e metodologias.

**********
Requisitos
**********

* Ensino superior completo em Design Gráfico, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Design Digital ou áreas correlatas.
* Experiência sólida em criação de campanhas para marketing digital e tráfego pago.
* Domínio de branding aplicado à performance.
* Experiência no desenvolvimento de key visuals e campanhas integradas.
* Conhecimento avançado em UX/UI e construção de Landing Pages.
* Domínio de Motion Design e edição profissional de vídeo.
* Experiência com frameworks visuais, metodologias criativas e Design Thinking.
* Capacidade de interpretar métricas estratégicas e direcionar otimizações visuais.
* Experiência em criação e análise de testes A/B e testes multivariáveis.

title: Graphic Designer & Web Manager
description:
*Graphic Designer & Web Manager*

*Department: Marketing & Communications*

*Reports to: Executive Director of Marketing, Communications & Engagement*

*Location: Remote - US*

*Employment Type: Full-Time*

*Salary Range: $85,000-90,000/year*

*Position Overview*

Minerva University is seeking a versatile and highly skilled Graphic Designer & Web Manager to support the university’s visual brand across print, digital, and web channels.

At its core, this is a hands-on graphic design role responsible for creating high-quality materials for Marketing & Communications and departments across the university. The role will manage a wide range of internal creative requests, from brochures, flyers, presentations, and event collateral to digital graphics and institutional materials, while ensuring consistent application of Minerva’s visual identity and brand standards.

The position will also play a significant role in maintaining and improving the Minerva University website using Webflow and will provide video editing and digital creative support as needed.

The ideal candidate is an experienced designer who is equally comfortable developing a polished print piece, building or updating a webpage, editing a short video, and helping colleagues translate their ideas into effective, on-brand creative.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Graphic Design & Internal Creative Support — 45%*

* Design high-quality print and digital materials, including brochures, flyers, one-pagers, presentations, reports, event collateral, signage, advertisements, institutional materials, and other branded assets.
* Fulfill creative requests from departments across the university, translating stakeholder needs into effective visual solutions.
* Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting established deadlines.
* Create and maintain reusable templates for presentations, documents, events, and other recurring university needs.
* Prepare production-ready files and coordinate with printers and other vendors when necessary.
* Provide graphics and other creative assets to support social media, enrollment marketing, institutional communications, events, and digital campaigns.
* Collaborate with Minerva’s Social Media Manager to create graphics and visual assets for social channels as needed.

*Website Design & Webflow Management — 30%*

* Maintain and update the Minerva University website using Webflow.
* Build and update webpages and page components within Minerva’s established design system.
* Make design and layout improvements that enhance usability, readability, and the overall user experience.
* Work with stakeholders across the university to ensure academic, admissions, programmatic, and institutional information remains accurate and current.
* Optimize images and other visual assets for web performance and accessibility.
* Support ongoing website quality assurance, including identifying and correcting visual inconsistencies, broken elements, and formatting issues.
* Assist with basic SEO implementation and website optimization.
* Help evolve the website as Minerva’s programs, content, and marketing needs change.

*Brand Management & Visual Standards — 15%*

* Serve as a day-to-day steward of Minerva’s visual identity and ensure consistent application of brand standards across university materials.
* Review creative materials and provide guidance to colleagues to ensure appropriate use of Minerva’s logos, typography, colors, imagery, and other visual elements.
* Maintain and organize brand assets, templates, and creative resources.
* Develop new templates, tools, and guidelines that enable teams across the university to create consistent, on-brand materials.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen and evolve Minerva’s visual identity while maintaining overall brand consistency.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external creative partners to ensure work meets Minerva’s brand and quality standards.

*Video & Multimedia — 10%*

* Edit short-form and promotional video content for digital campaigns, the website, social media, events, and other university needs.
* Transform existing footage, photography, graphics, and other assets into polished video content.
* Incorporate graphics, titles, captions, music, and other elements as appropriate.
* Resize and adapt video content for different platforms and formats.
* Provide multimedia support for enrollment, institutional, and storytelling initiatives as needed.

Requirements
------------

*Qualifications*

*Required*

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in graphic design, visual communication, digital design, or a related field.
* Professional graphic design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating print, digital, and brand work.
* Advanced proficiency in Canva and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, visual hierarchy, composition, and brand systems.
* Experience designing for both print and digital environments.
* Experience maintaining websites using Webflow or a comparable CMS/web design platform.
* Experience with video editing using Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable software.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining brand consistency.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with non-designers and translating stakeholder needs into creative solutions.

*Preferred*

* Advanced experience with Webflow, including page building and responsive design.
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Experience with UX/UI and responsive web design principles.
* Experience with motion graphics or animation.
* Experience developing and maintaining organizational brand guidelines and template systems.
* Familiarity with Canva and creating templates for use by non-designers.
* Understanding of SEO, website accessibility, and web optimization.
* Experience designing for enrollment, higher education, or other mission-driven organizations.

*What Success Looks Like*

The successful candidate will become a trusted creative resource across Minerva, producing high-quality work while helping ensure that the university presents a consistent and distinctive visual identity across every touchpoint.

They will be a designer first, but with the digital skills and versatility to manage substantial website work, provide video support, and help colleagues across the university turn their needs into polished, effective creative.

Success in this role means Minerva’s materials are consistently on brand, internal design requests are handled efficiently, the website remains visually strong and up to date, and the Marketing & Communications team has the creative capacity to support the university’s evolving needs.
