title: Graphic Designer
description:
------------
*Who we are*
------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

----------
*The role*
----------

The work is unlike anything you've done before.

Defence. Autonomous aircraft. Sovereign AI. Ethics. These are not the usual inputs for a graphic designer. But they are yours now, and the question of how you communicate them, visually, with precision and intelligence, is one of the most interesting design problems in Europe right now.

This is a high-output role. You will be the engine of a fast-moving creative team, executing across the full range of Helsing's visual output.

----------------
*The day-to-day*
----------------

* Design web pages, social content, and digital assets

* Create exhibition stands, event environments, and branded experiences

* Develop identities for new and existing products or partnerships

* Design product brochures, technical publications, and campaign materials that make complex ideas feel inevitable

* Build presentations shown to the highest levels of government and industry

* Work across clothing, merchandise, and brand objects

* Own projects from brief to production, managing timelines, vendors, and your own judgment

-------------------------
*You should apply if you*
-------------------------

* Have a portfolio demonstrating high-quality work across diverse formats and disciplines. P *lease include a PDF or link, with any relevant websites or videos*

* Your portfolio shows range: you have worked across formats, found solutions that feel inevitable in retrospect, and done the legwork to make things excellent

* You are comfortable with feedback, fast iteration, and working in an environment with multiple stakeholders

* You can manage several projects simultaneously without losing quality on any of them

* You take pride in the craft

* Have a rigorous understanding of typography, colour theory, layout, and composition

* Can translate complex, abstract, and technical subject matter into clear and compelling visuals

* Are experienced building presentations and visualising proposals

* Are organised, self-directed, and able to anticipate what a project needs before you're asked

* Are intellectually curious, prepared to learn a lot about autonomous systems, military doctrine, and AI

* Are proficient in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)

* Are comfortable being wrong, getting notes, and making the work better for it

Note: We work in a field where women and other minority groups are systematically under-represented. We actively encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every listed qualification. Potential and craft cannot be reduced to a checklist.

Send us your portfolio. Show us how you think.

--------------
*Nice to Have*
--------------

*

Another creative skill such as copywriting, photography or videography

*

Knowledge of After Effects or Premiere

*

A second language, ideally French or German

------------------------------------------------------------------
*Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields*
------------------------------------------------------------------

*

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

*

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

*

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

*

In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

*

We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

---------------
*What we offer*
---------------

*

*Competitive salary* and *VSOP options*

*

*Relocation support* : up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

*

*Learning* : €500/£450 yearly allowance

*

*Health & wellness* : gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

*

*Social* : regularly company events and monthly social allowances

*

*Enhanced parental leave* : 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.

*

*Family support:* 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Ad Designer
description:
is the leading AI teammate for meetings, trusted by more than 20 million users across over 500,000 organizations, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Fireflies captures knowledge, automates repetitive work, and helps teams become more productive before, during, and after every meeting.

Fireflies has achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion. In 2024, Ramp recognized Fireflies as the sixth most popular AI platform by number of paying customers, alongside companies including OpenAI, Midjourney, and Anthropic. There is a good chance you have already seen Fireflies quietly powering one of your recent meetings.

We're hiring an *Ad Designer* to become the dedicated creative engine behind our Meta, Instagram, and social ad output. Today, ad turnaround runs through founders and the design lead directly — every cricket-sponsorship creative, every carousel, every quick test. We want that to change: *someone who can own the full loop from "here's an insight" to "here are 10 variations live and being tested," in hours, not days.*

This isn't a "make it look nice" role. It's for someone who thinks like a marketer first — who can sit inside Meta Ads Manager, form a real opinion about why an ad is or isn't working, and turn that opinion into the next creative before being asked.

---------------
What you'll do:
---------------

* Design high-performing ad creative for Meta, Instagram, and other paid social channels — statics, carousels, and short-form video assets
* Take one working ad and rapidly produce *10+ variations* (copy, colour, format, hook) to keep testing and scaling what performs
* Handle basic video clipping - repurposing raw founder/event/product footage into short-form social and ad-ready clips
* Live inside *Meta Ads Manager* : track performance, study competitors and industry trends, and use that data to decide what to design next
* Turn around carousels and quick-test creative in *hours, not days* - speed is part of the job, not a nice-to-have
* Partner directly with founders and the marketing/design team on messaging, testing hypotheses, and creative direction
* Own visual execution end-to-end, concept to shipped ad , without needing a designer to be looped in on every asset
* Build a reusable system of ad templates and winning formats so output scales without reinventing each brief

----------------------
Who we're looking for:
----------------------

* *You think like a marketer who designs, not a designer who makes ads look nice.* You have a real opinion on what copy will land, what colours will work, what visual stops the scroll, and what makes a value prop instantly understandable.
* A portfolio or reel that shows *live, shipped ad creative* - ideally with a sense of what performed and why, not just concept work
* Strong graphic design fundamentals: layout, colour, typography, and an instinct for what gets attention on Meta/IG
* Comfort with basic video editing/clipping for short-form social and ad placements
* A bias for speed and iteration - you'd rather ship 10 variants of something that's already working today than polish one thing for a week
* Real experience close to performance advertising - you've run ad accounts yourself, or worked tightly enough with founders/marketers to understand what the data is telling you
* Ability to work quickly, communicate clearly over Slack, and overlap with *US Pacific or European working hours*

*Strong plus:* You've personally run or scaled an ad account, an Instagram page, or a creator/brand page from scratch — we'd rather see that than an agency résumé. We're also widening our aperture beyond typical SaaS design: backgrounds in luxury, fashion, entertainment, sports, hospitality, or agency work are all welcome. Portfolio beats pedigree.

------------
How to apply
------------

Send us:

* Your *portfolio or reel* of ad creative
* *One ad you designed that performed well* - and your read on why it worked
* Your typical turnaround time for a quick-turn carousel or ad variation set

-------------------
What matters to us:
-------------------

* You're a strong communicator and contribute positively to the team
* You take ownership and have an internal compass
* You value candid feedback and overcommunication
* You care about quality and design, while keeping things simple
* You measure your impact and look for ways to improve and automate
* You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and getting a little better every week
* You're customer-focused and care about the end result, not just the output
* You value fast, incremental ways of working

-----------------
Perks & benefits:
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* Work remotely from anywhere in your respective country
* Flexible working hours
* Paid time off and flexible leave policy
* Ability to move laterally within the team and grow quickly
* No-boss culture
* LGBTQ+ friendly workplace
* Company offsites
* Tech reimbursements

At , we're changing how teams use AI in their daily work. Our culture is built around security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19M from investors including Canaan and Khosla Ventures, along with angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is a global team of 100+ people across 20+ countries and every time zone. We're building a global-first company and use our own product every day to help us work better.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Junior Product Designer – Home Décor

Employment Type: Full-Time
Initial Salary: ₹8,000 per month

About the Company

We are an MDF laser-cutting and manufacturing company specializing in creating innovative and attractive home décor products using laser-cutting technology.

Our products include wall décor, decorative panels, layered artwork, personalized décor, and various other MDF-based products designed for modern homes and commercial spaces.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic Junior Product Designer who is interested in learning how designs are developed and converted into real, physical products.

You will work on designing various home décor products for laser cutting, while gaining practical, real-time experience in product design, manufacturing, and the home décor industry.

No extensive prior experience is required. We will train the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities

* Design creative and attractive MDF home décor products.
* Develop designs suitable for laser cutting and manufacturing.
* Create and modify designs based on product requirements.
* Work on different types of products such as:
* Wall art
* Layered MDF designs
* Decorative panels
* Nameplates and personalized products
* Geometric and modern décor
* Other innovative home décor products
* Understand how a digital design is converted into a physical manufactured product.
* Modify designs based on manufacturing limitations and requirements.
* Research current home décor trends and develop new product ideas.
* Work closely with the production team to improve designs and ensure they are practical to manufacture.
* Learn professional design workflows, laser-cutting requirements, and product development processes.

What We Will Provide

This role is designed as a learning + practical experience opportunity.

You will receive training and hands-on experience in:

* Product design
* MDF product designing
* Laser-cutting design requirements
* Preparing designs for manufacturing
* Creating layered artwork
* Product development
* Understanding materials and dimensions
* Converting concepts into actual physical products
* Home décor trends and product ideation
* Real-world manufacturing workflows

You will not just be creating sample designs—you will see your designs actually being manufactured and turned into products.

Who We Are Looking For

* Creative and willing to learn.
* Basic understanding of design principles.
* Interest in product design, home décor, or manufacturing.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Familiarity with any design software is an advantage, but not mandatory.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Candidates with experience in CorelDRAW, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, AutoCAD, or similar design software will be preferred.
* Ability to understand feedback and improve designs.
* Good attention to detail.
* Creative thinking and willingness to experiment with new ideas.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to build real industry experience in a growing manufacturing and home décor business.

You will learn how products are conceptualized → designed → prepared for laser cutting → manufactured → turned into finished home décor products.

The goal is to help you develop practical design skills while working on real commercial products, rather than only theoretical or practice projects.

Salary

Starting Salary: ₹8,000/month

Salary growth will be based on skills, performance, creativity, learning ability, and contribution to the company.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who is creative, curious, willing to learn, and genuinely interested in turning designs into physical products.

Freshers with the right attitude are encouraged to apply.

title: UI\UX Designer
description:
Ми у пошуках ініціативного дизайнера з гострим оком на деталі, який не чекає вказівок, а сам бачить, де можна зробити краще. Якщо вас захоплює складна анімація, сильний візуал і креативний підхід до UI — ми чекаємо на ваше портфоліо.

Кого ми шукаємо

Нам потрібна людина із сильним візуальним чуттям та креативним підходом до UI: вміння створювати дизайн зі складними анімаціями і розуміння того, як їх реалізувати на практиці. Окремо цінуємо досвід або щирий інтерес до UX/UI дизайну ігор.

Що потрібно вміти

Вільне володіння Figma — це базова вимога.
Готовність підхопити вже існуючі проєкти, вникнути в контекст і самостійно покращувати їх.
Вміння будувати дизайн-системи з нуля або розвивати наявні.
Активне використання AI-інструментів та вайбкодінгу у щоденній роботі — не просто цікавість, а вже вбудований у процеси робочий інструмент.
Вміння створювати прототипи, візуалізації та продумані користувацькі сценарії.
Навички роботи з анімацією в дизайні.

Що пропонуємо
Можливість розвиватися в різних напрямках дизайну: мобільні додатки, великі продукти, крипто-проєкти, ігри, креативні лендінги зі складними анімаціями.
Конкурентоспроможну заробітну плату, що виплачується своєчасно.
Перегляд зарплати залежно від результатів роботи.
Гнучкий робочий графік.
Сучасне обладнання для ефективної роботи.
Корпоративну культуру з регулярними корпоративними заходами.

Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.

VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.

VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.

Role

AGM-UI/UX Designer

Band

M2

Function

Digital

Location

Mumbai

Job Purpose

Someone who has B2C/B2B digital experiences across web & mobile. The incumbent will be responsible to work in a continuous improvement model with tech, product, design, analytics & business teams and build intuitive, memorable & scalable experiences. He/she should be willing to focus on self, team and the design chapter with core focus on the deliverables of your squad/team.

Responsibilities

-  Understand product specifications and user psychology by asking the right questions, looking at primary and secondary research 2. Conduct concept and usability testing and gather feedback 3. Create personas through user research and data 4. Define the right interaction model and evaluate its success 5. Develop wireframes and prototypes around customer needs 6. Find creative ways to solve UX problems (e.g. usability, findability, human experience led, transformative design) 7. Work with UI designers to implement memorable, high attention to detail & high craftsmanship in designs 8. Communicate design ideas and prototypes to developers, business and other stakeholders across digital 9. Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends

Requirements And Skills

- Proven experience as a UI/UX Designer, research experience is a big plus
- Strong portfolio of design projects (consumer preferred, enterprise, trade & retail also works)
- Background in project management and research
- Proficient with interaction design and information architecture
- Proficient in SDLC software like Figma, Zeplin, JIRA, Adobe CS & Google Suite is a must
- Knowledge of HTML/CSS; Flutter, JavaScript is a plus Problem-solving aptitude
- Analytical mind with a interest in business
- Excellent communication & presentation skills

Must have technical/professional qualification

Engineering degree with 2-3 years of work experience MBA or Masters would also be a preferable qualification

UI/UX Designer
Experience: 3 - 6 Years
Location: Chennai (On-site)
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
We’re looking for a UI/UX Designer who blends creativity with clarity. Someone who can turn complex ideas into intuitive, elegant digital experiences. At Roanuz, you won’t just design screens, you’ll design experiences that power AI-driven sports technology used globally.
You’ll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business teams to craft interfaces that are functional, scalable, and delightful.

What You’ll Do
- Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes for web and mobile products.
- Conduct user research, usability testing, and feedback analysis to refine design decisions.
- Partner with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.
- Contribute to and evolve our design systems, ensuring consistency and scalability.
- Simplify complex AI and sports data workflows into intuitive user journeys.
- Stay current with design trends, accessibility standards, and interaction patterns.

What We’re Looking For
- 3 - 6 years of proven experience in UI/UX design with a strong portfolio showcasing real-world product work.
- Proficiency in Figma (Sketch or equivalent tools is a plus).
- Deep understanding of user-centered design, responsive design, and usability principles.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills.
- Experience designing for web, mobile, or SaaS platforms.
- Must be located in commutable distance to Tamil Nadu, India

Nice to Have
- Strong visual/artistic skills (illustration or drawing ability is a bonus).
- Interest in sports and familiarity with sports ecosystems.
- Experience working in sports tech or data-driven products.

What You’ll Get
- Competitive compensation and benefits.
- Exposure to AI-led product innovation in sports tech.
- A collaborative and idea-driven work environment.
- Real ownership and impact on global products.
- Flexible work culture.

About Roanuz
Roanuz builds intelligent products powered by practical artificial intelligence. Since 2012, we’ve been focused on AI research and development - creating our own in-house AI framework and redefining how sports data is collected, analyzed, and experienced globally.

Why Roanuz?
At Roanuz, you don’t just join a company - you join a team that thrives on solving complex, real-world problems. We move fast, think deeply, and build products that make a tangible impact in the global sports technology ecosystem.
If you’re someone who loves blending design thinking with cutting-edge technology, you’ll feel right at home here.

Mobile UI/Visual Designer

Black Horse IT — продуктова IT-компанія, яка створює та розвиває мобільні застосунки у різних нішах.

Що потрібно робити
Дизайн мобільних застосунків для iOS та Android.
Створення сучасного та привабливого UI для різних ніш.

Дизайн onboarding, paywall, subscription screens та ключових екранів продукту.

Покращення існуючих інтерфейсів та їхньої візуальної подачі.
Робота з референсами та конкурентами.
Підготовка дизайну, який добре виглядає не лише у Figma, а й у реальному App Store та на мобільному пристрої.

Що для нас важливо
Сильний візуальний смак та хороша дизайн-насмотреність.
Портфоліо з реальними мобільними застосунками.
Впевнене володіння Figma.
Розуміння iOS UI/UX та сучасних mobile design patterns.
Вміння створювати App Store Screenshots, paywalls та onboarding, які виглядають як у якісних комерційних продуктів.
Вміння самостійно приймати дизайнерські рішення.
Здатність працювати за коротким брифом: зрозуміти задачу, знайти референси, запропонувати концепцію та реалізувати її.
Увага до типографіки, композиції, кольору, spacing та візуальної ієрархії.

Буде перевагою
Досвід роботи із subscription apps.
Досвід створення App Store / Google Play Screenshots.
Розуміння conversion-oriented design.
Досвід роботи з AI apps, utilities, productivity та іншими consumer mobile products.
Вміння використовувати AI-інструменти для створення візуалів та концептів.

Формат роботи
Проєктна робота.
100% віддалено.
Різні мобільні продукти та ніші.
Можливість довгострокової співпраці після успішних проєктів.
Оплата обговорюється індивідуально.

У процесі відбору буде невелике тестове завдання.
Ми оцінюємо не лише знання Figma, а насамперед смак, насмотреність, самостійність та якість фінального візуального результату.

title: Freelance Presentation Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do
----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
* Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
* Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
* Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
* Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started
------------------

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
* Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
* Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
* Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

*Additional requirements*

* Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
* Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.*

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$30 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer

**ON-SITE ROLE: APPLICANTS MUST BE ABLE TO WORK IN PERSON AT OUR PHOENIX, AZ LOCATION. THIS IS NOT A REMOTE POSITION.*

JOB DESCRIPTION

Owns independent execution of assigned design work across print, packaging, in-store signage/displays, digital collateral, social media, and event materials. Works from a brief or business objective to a finished, on-brand deliverable with minimal oversight, and is expected to bring creative judgment to the work — not just execute instructions literally.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Design and produce marketing materials across print and digital — brochures, flyers, reports, presentations, social graphics, event materials, and other branded assets
* Support both dispensary/market-specific marketing and corporate campaigns across Grow Science's multi-state footprint
* Conceptualize and develop creative solutions from written briefs, verbal direction, or business objectives, working independently once direction is set
* Apply cannabis packaging compliance requirements without prompting
* Maintain and elevate Grow Science brand standards across all creative materials
* Provide creative input on briefs and concepts — flag weak direction and propose better solutions rather than executing as literally instructed
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail
* Prepare final production files for print and digital, ensuring accuracy and correct specifications
* Coordinate with print and production vendors as needed — bids, artwork prep, production requirements, final review
* Assist with video and motion graphics projects as needed
* Maintain advanced, current knowledge of Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, the broader Adobe Creative Suite and relevant design tools
* Perform other duties in support of business objectives as assigned

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:
----------------------

* Scheduled hours: 8am–4pm M–F. Attendance and punctuality are core job requirements, not courtesies
* Absences or lateness communicated in advance; undocumented or last-minute absences are treated as a conduct issue, not a scheduling issue
* Standard-complexity tasks turned around per the timeline agreed at assignment
* Works independently once a brief is set — does not require step-by-step direction to reach a finished, on-brand deliverable
* Delays communicated proactively, before the deadline, with a revised delivery estimate — an explanation given after a deadline has passed does not satisfy this standard
* Status on all active projects kept current daily

The job description defines the general requirements and level of work. The description is not a complete list of all required responsibilities, duties and skill requirements. Other responsibilities may be added and the job description may be changed at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - EXPERIENCE/TRAINING/EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION/ETC.

* High School Diploma or G.E.D. equivalent required.
* Knowledge of the cannabis plant.
* Knowledge and understanding of current medical and recreational marijuana laws.
* Experience in a dispensary or assembly line production environment recommended.

Specific state regulatory requirements also include verification, confirmation or completion of the following:

* Must be twenty-one (21) years of age; pursuant to A.R.S. §36-2801.10
* Must consent to a criminal background check performed by the Company and/or the Arizona Department of Health Services, pursuant to A.R.S. § 36-2804.01
* Employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of the criminal background check conducted by the Arizona Department of Health Services, pursuant to A.R.S. §36-2804.01 and A.R.S. §36-2801.10
* Valid Arizona State Issued ID

*JOB TYPE:* *Full-time*

*BENEFITS:*

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

title: Graphic Designer + Landing Page Developer
description:
*Graphic Designer & Landing Page Developer (Conversion-Focused) – Remote*
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

*Position Type:* Full-Time, Remote
*Working Hours:* U.S. Business Hours (EST Preferred)

*About the Role*
----------------

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a *Graphic Designer & Landing Page Developer* to create high-performing marketing creatives and conversion-focused landing pages that drive measurable business results.

This is more than a traditional design role. You’ll own both the creative and technical execution of marketing campaigns by designing digital assets, building responsive landing pages, and continuously optimizing user experiences to improve lead generation and conversion rates.

If you enjoy combining creativity with performance marketing, understand user behavior, and can independently launch polished landing pages, this role is an excellent fit.

*What You’ll Own*
-----------------

*Creative Design*
-----------------

* Design high-converting marketing assets, including:

* Paid ad creatives
* Social media graphics
* Display banners
* Email graphics
* Promotional visuals

* Maintain brand consistency across all campaigns.
* Translate campaign messaging into compelling, performance-focused creative.
* Support marketing initiatives with engaging visual content.

*Landing Page Design & Development*
-----------------------------------

* Design modern, responsive landing pages.
* Build and launch pages using:

* Webflow
* Framer
* Similar no-code/low-code platforms

* Optimize pages for:

* Desktop
* Tablet
* Mobile

* Independently manage projects from design through production.

*UX/UI & Conversion Optimization*
---------------------------------

* Improve layouts, user flows, and page structure to increase conversions.
* Apply UX/UI best practices across:

* Landing pages
* Forms
* Calls-to-action
* Visual hierarchy

* Support A/B testing and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives.
* Continuously improve pages based on user behavior and campaign performance.

*Collaboration & Campaign Support*
----------------------------------

* Partner closely with:

* Marketing teams
* Copywriters
* Leadership
* Campaign stakeholders

* Execute creative requests while maintaining quality and consistency.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Update and optimize existing landing pages and marketing assets.

*What Success Looks Like*
-------------------------

* Landing pages launch quickly and accurately.
* Marketing creatives improve engagement and campaign performance.
* Pages are responsive, polished, and optimized for conversions.
* Brand consistency is maintained across all deliverables.
* Design work directly contributes to higher conversion rates and lead generation.

*What Makes You a Strong Fit*
-----------------------------

* You understand how design influences user behavior and conversions.
* You can independently design, build, and launch landing pages.
* You think in terms of:

* User journeys
* Funnels
* Engagement
* Performance

* You balance creativity with speed and execution.
* You have exceptional attention to detail and design consistency.
* You thrive in fast-paced marketing environments.

*Required Experience & Skills*
------------------------------

*Design & Creative*
-------------------

* Proficiency with one or more of:

* Figma
* Adobe XD
* Sketch

* Strong portfolio demonstrating:

* Landing pages
* Paid advertising creatives
* Digital marketing assets
* Conversion-focused design

* Strong understanding of:

* UX/UI principles
* Responsive design
* Visual hierarchy
* User behavior

*Landing Page Development*
--------------------------

* Hands-on experience with:

* Webflow
* Framer
* Similar landing page builders

* Ability to independently:

* Design
* Build
* Launch
* Optimize landing pages

* Experience creating responsive, high-performing pages.

*Execution & Collaboration*
---------------------------

* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently.
* Comfortable working remotely in a fast-paced environment.

*Nice-to-Have*
--------------

* Experience in:

* Performance marketing
* Growth marketing
* Paid media environments

* Knowledge of:

* A/B testing
* Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
* SEO best practices

* Basic front-end skills:

* HTML
* CSS
* React
* Next.js

* Familiarity with:

* Git/GitHub
* Advanced prototyping
* Motion graphics or animation

*Tools & Platforms*
-------------------

* Figma
* Adobe XD
* Sketch
* Webflow
* Framer
* Canva
* HTML/CSS
* GitHub
* Google Workspace

*What a Typical Day Looks Like*
-------------------------------

* Design marketing creatives for paid campaigns.
* Build and launch responsive landing pages.
* Optimize layouts and conversion flows.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on campaign execution.
* Update and improve existing landing pages.
* Test usability across multiple devices.
* Manage multiple creative and development projects simultaneously.

*In short:* You create visually compelling marketing assets and high-converting landing pages that directly improve campaign performance, lead generation, and user experience.

*Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)*
--------------------------------

* Landing page conversion rates.
* Speed and accuracy of landing page launches.
* Quality and consistency of creative assets.
* Campaign performance improvements driven by design.
* Efficient management of multiple projects.
* Mobile responsiveness and user experience quality.

*Why Join Us?*
--------------

* Own both design and landing page development.
* Directly impact marketing performance and lead generation.
* Work on:

* Landing pages
* Performance marketing campaigns
* Conversion optimization
* Digital brand experiences

* Blend creative design with technical execution.
* Growth opportunities into:

* Senior Designer
* CRO Designer
* Growth Designer
* Creative Lead
* Webflow/Framer Specialist

*Interview Process*
-------------------

* Initial Phone Screen
* *Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)*
* Recruiter Interview
* Client Interview
* Offer & Onboarding

*What Happens After You Apply*
------------------------------

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from *Spark Hire* to record your *Intro Video*. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your *inbox* and *spam folder* for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

*Apply Now*
-----------

If you’re passionate about creating high-converting landing pages, designing marketing assets that drive measurable results, and combining creativity with performance marketing, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build digital experiences that increase engagement, conversions, and business growth.
